class_talents.description: Your blood freezes, granting immunity to Stun effects and reducing all damage you take by 30% for 8 sec.
class_talents.name: Icebound Fortitude

class_talents.description: Focuses dark power into a strike that deals 18,265 Physical damage and heals you for 24.15% of all damage taken in the last 5 sec, minimum 8.5% of maximum health.
class_talents.name: Death Strike

class_talents.description: Raises a ghoul to fight by your side.  You can have a maximum of one ghoul at a time. Lasts 1 min.
class_talents.name: Raise Dead

class_talents.description: Auto attacks have a chance to generate 3 Runic Power.
class_talents.name: Runic Attenuation

class_talents.description: Death Strike's cost is reduced by 5, and its healing is increased by 15%.
class_talents.name: Improved Death Strike

class_talents.description:
Heart Strike hits up to 3 additional enemies while you remain in Death and Decay.

When leaving your Death and Decay you retain its bonus effects for 4 sec.
class_talents.name: Cleaving Strikes

class_talents.description: Smash the target's mind with cold, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.
class_talents.name: Mind Freeze

class_talents.description:
Targets in a cone in front of you are blinded, causing them to wander disoriented for 5 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

When Blinding Sleet ends, enemies are slowed by 50% for 6 sec.
class_talents.name: Blinding Sleet

class_talents.description: Absorbs are 30% more effective on you.
class_talents.name: Gloom Ward

class_talents.description: Death's Advance grants an additional 25% movement speed over the first 3 sec.
class_talents.name: March of Darkness

class_talents.description: Increases Haste by 4%.
class_talents.name: Unholy Momentum

class_talents.description: Successfully interrupting an enemy with Mind Freeze grants 10 Runic Power and reduces its cooldown by 3 sec.
class_talents.name: Coldthirst

class_talents.description: Your auto attack damage grants you an absorb shield equal to 50% of the damage dealt.
class_talents.name: Permafrost

class_talents.description: Stamina increased by 20%.
class_talents.name: Veteran of the Third War

class_talents.description: Your diseases have a chance to weaken your enemy causing your attacks against them to deal 6% increased damage for 5 sec.
class_talents.name: Brittle

class_talents.description: Your Runic Power spending abilities increase your melee attack speed by 6% for 10 sec, stacking up to 3 times.
class_talents.name: Icy Talons

class_talents.description: Places an Anti-Magic Zone for 6 sec, reducing the magic damage taken by party or raid members by 15%.
class_talents.name: Anti-Magic Zone

class_talents.description: Increases the effectiveness of your Runeforge effects by 20%.
class_talents.name: Unholy Bond

class_talents.description:
Increases the range of Death Grip by 10 yds.

Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor resets the cooldown of Death Grip.
class_talents.name: Death's Reach

class_talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Anti-Magic Shell by 20 sec and increases its duration and amount absorbed by 40%.
class_talents.name: Anti-Magic Barrier

class_talents.description: Death and Decay reduces the movement speed of enemies within its area by 90%, decaying by 10% every sec.
class_talents.name: Grip of the Dead

class_talents.description: Damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 3%. When suffering a loss of control effect, this bonus is increased by an additional 6% for 6 sec.
class_talents.name: Suppression

class_talents.description: Increases Leech by 3%.
class_talents.name: Blood Scent

class_talents.description: Increases Lichborne duration by 2 sec and reduces the cooldown by 30 sec.
class_talents.name: Unholy Endurance

class_talents.description: Your auto-attacks reduce the target's auto-attack speed by 5% for 30 sec, stacking up to 4 times.
class_talents.name: Insidious Chill

class_talents.description: Your chance to be critically struck is reduced by 3% and your Armor is increased by 6%.
class_talents.name: Runic Protection

class_talents.description:
When you fall below 30% health you drain 5,356 health from nearby enemies, the damage you take is reduced by 10% and your Death Strike cost is reduced by 10 for 8 sec.

Can only occur every 2 min.
class_talents.name: Blood Draw

class_talents.description: Consuming a Rune has a chance to increase your Strength by 6% for 8 sec.
class_talents.name: Rune Mastery

class_talents.description: Damage taken below 30% Health is reduced by 35%.
class_talents.name: Will of the Necropolis

class_talents.description: Magic damage taken is reduced by 8% and the duration of harmful Magic effects against you are reduced by 35%.
class_talents.name: Null Magic

class_talents.description: Death's Advance, Death and Decay, and Death Grip have 1 additional charge.
class_talents.name: Death's Echo

hero_talents.description:
Your Death Coil and Death Strike have a 35% chance to make your next Heart Strike become Vampiric Strike.

Vampiric Strike heals you for 1% of your maximum health and grants you Essence of the Blood Queen, increasing your Haste by 1.0%, up to 7.0% for 25 sec.
hero_talents.name: Vampiric Strike

hero_talents.description:
Death's Advance and Wraith Walk movement speed bonuses are increased by 10%.

Activating Death's Advance or Wraith Walk increases 4 nearby allies movement speed by 20% for 5 sec.
hero_talents.name: Vampiric Speed

hero_talents.description: While you are within your Death and Decay, your physical damage taken is reduced by 8% and your chance to gain Vampiric Strike is increased by 5%.
hero_talents.name: Blood-Soaked Ground

hero_talents.description:
Icebound Fortitude reduces all damage you take by up to an additional 20% based on your missing health.

Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor reduces the cooldown of Icebound Fortitude by 3 sec.
hero_talents.name: Bloody Fortitude

hero_talents.description:
Essence of the Blood Queen additionally increases your Mastery by 1.0% per stack.

Blood Plague deals 5% increased damage.
hero_talents.name: Thrill of Blood

hero_talents.description: When Vampiric Strike damages an enemy affected by your Blood Plague, it extends the duration of the disease by 3.0 sec, and deals 20% of the remaining damage to the enemy.
hero_talents.name: Infliction of Sorrow

hero_talents.description: Essence of the Blood Queen stacks 2 additional times and increases the damage of your Death Coil and Death Strike by 5% per stack.
hero_talents.name: Frenzied Bloodthirst

hero_talents.description:
Dancing Rune Weapon summons a Blood Beast to attack your enemy for 10 sec.

Each time the Blood Beast attacks, it stores a portion of the damage dealt. When the Blood Beast dies, it explodes, dealing 15% of the damage accumulated to nearby enemies and healing the Death Knight for the same amount. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
hero_talents.name: The Blood is Life

hero_talents.description: When Crimson Scourge is consumed, you gain 6% Strength for 12 sec.
hero_talents.name: Visceral Strength

hero_talents.description: Blood Plague deals up to 30% increased damage based on the target's missing health.
hero_talents.name: Inevitable

hero_talents.description:
Vampiric Strike and Heart Strike cause your targets to take 1% increased Shadow damage, up to 5% for 15 sec.

Vampiric Strike benefits from Incite Terror at 400% effectiveness.
hero_talents.name: Incite Terror

hero_talents.description: You store 15% of all Shadow damage dealt into your Blood Beast to explode for additional damage when it expires.
hero_talents.name: Pact of the San'layn

hero_talents.description:
Vampiric Strike increases the damage of your Dancing Rune Weapons by 20% for 8 sec.

Multiple applications may overlap.
hero_talents.name: Transfusion

hero_talents.description:
While Dancing Rune Weapon is active you gain Gift of the San'layn.

Gift of the San'layn increases the effectiveness of your Essence of the Blood Queen by 200%, and Vampiric Strike replaces your Heart Strike for the duration.
hero_talents.name: Gift of the San'layn

spec_talents.description: Instantly strike the target and 1 other nearby enemy, causing 11,494 Physical damage, and reducing enemies' movement speed by 20% for 8 sec, plus 2 Runic Power per additional enemy struck.
spec_talents.name: Heart Strike

spec_talents.description:
Smash the target, dealing 9,790 Physical damage and generating 3 charges of Bone Shield.

 Bone Shield
Surrounds you with a barrier of whirling bones, increasing Armor by 4,050. Each melee attack against you consumes a charge. Lasts 30 sec or until all charges are consumed.
spec_talents.name: Marrowrend

spec_talents.description:
Deals 7,300 Shadow damage and infects all enemies within 10 yds with Blood Plague.

 Blood Plague
A shadowy disease that drains 14,768 health from the target over 24 sec.
spec_talents.name: Blood Boil

spec_talents.description: Embrace your undeath, increasing your maximum health by 30% and increasing all healing and absorbs received by 40% for 14 sec.
spec_talents.name: Vampiric Blood

spec_talents.description:
When you would pull an enemy generate 1 charge of Bone Shield.

 Bone Shield
Surrounds you with a barrier of whirling bones, increasing Armor by 4,050. Each melee attack against you consumes a charge. Lasts 30 sec or until all charges are consumed.
spec_talents.name: Bone Collector

spec_talents.description:
While you have at least 5 Bone Shield charges, the cost of Death Strike is reduced by 5 Runic Power.

Additionally, your maximum Runic Power is increased by 10.
spec_talents.name: Ossuary

spec_talents.description: Vampiric Blood's healing and absorb amount is increased by 10% and duration by 4 sec.
spec_talents.name: Improved Vampiric Blood

spec_talents.description: Heart Strike damage increased by 30%.
spec_talents.name: Improved Heart Strike

spec_talents.description: Your Heart Strike generates 2 additional Runic Power per target hit.
spec_talents.name: Heartbreaker

spec_talents.description: Each charge of Bone Shield increases your maximum health by 1%.
spec_talents.name: Foul Bulwark

spec_talents.description:
Summons a rune weapon for 12 sec that mirrors your melee attacks and bolsters your defenses.

While active, you gain 30% parry chance.
spec_talents.name: Dancing Rune Weapon

spec_talents.description: Each enemy hit by Blood Boil increases the damage and healing done by your next Death Strike by 8%, stacking up to 5 times.
spec_talents.name: Hemostasis

spec_talents.description: Shadowy tendrils coil around all enemies within 15 yards of a hostile or friendly target, pulling them to the target's location and Silencing them for 3 sec.
spec_talents.name: Gorefiend's Grasp

spec_talents.description: Bone Shield increases your Haste by 10% and it can stack 2 additional times.
spec_talents.name: Improved Bone Shield

spec_talents.description: Dancing Rune Weapon's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec and now generates 5 Bone Shield charges.
spec_talents.name: Insatiable Blade

spec_talents.description: Death Strike hits an additional 2 enemies at 75% effectiveness.
spec_talents.name: Deadly Reach

spec_talents.description:
Your Blood Plague and Death and Decay deal damage 15% more often.

Additionally, your Blood Plague leeches 85% more Health.
spec_talents.name: Rapid Decomposition

spec_talents.description: Heart Strike has a chance to make your next Blood Boil empowered, dealing 50% increased damage and echoing after 3 sec.
spec_talents.name: Boiling Point

spec_talents.description: Summons 1 additional copy of Dancing Rune Weapon and increases its duration by 4 sec.
spec_talents.name: Everlasting Bond

spec_talents.description: Death Strike's healing is increased by 5% and grants you 15% Leech for 8 sec.
spec_talents.name: Voracious

spec_talents.description: Blood Shield's duration is increased by 2 sec and it absorbs 20% more damage.
spec_talents.name: Iron Heart

Parrying an attack grants you a charge of Bloodied Blade, increasing your Strength by 0.5%, up to 4.0% for 15 sec.

At 8 stacks, your next parry consumes all charges to unleash a Heart Strike at 300% effectiveness, and increases your Strength by 10% for 6 sec.
spec_talents.name: Bloodied Blade

spec_talents.description: Enemies affected by Blood Plague take 5% increased damage from you and Death Strike increases the damage of your Blood Plague by 10% for 15 sec, stacking up to 4 times.
spec_talents.name: Coagulopathy

spec_talents.description: You deal 6% more damage and receive 5% more healing while standing in your Death and Decay.
spec_talents.name: Sanguine Ground

spec_talents.description: While Blood Shield is active, you deal 8% increased damage and damage taken is reduced by 4%.
spec_talents.name: Bloodshot

spec_talents.description: Reduces the cooldown on Vampiric Blood by 2.0 sec per 10 Runic Power spent.
spec_talents.name: Red Thirst

spec_talents.name: Purgatory

spec_talents.description: After Vampiric Blood expires, you absorb damage equal to 6 times the damage your Blood Plague dealt during Vampiric Blood.

Obliterate consumes up to 3 stacks, dealing an additional 9 Frost damage for each stack consumed.
spec_nodes.name: Inexorable Assault

spec_nodes.description:
Obliterate deals 10% increased damage and has a chance to tether the souls of its target and a nearby enemy to yours.

Frost Strike severs the tethers, dealing 72 Shadowfrost damage to both foes.
spec_nodes.name: Frostreaper

spec_nodes.description: The power of frost increases your Strength by 20% for 12 sec.
spec_nodes.name: Pillar of Frost

spec_nodes.description:
Frost Strike and Glacial Advance now cause your next Frost Strike and Glacial Advance to deal 15% increased damage and cost 5 more Runic Power. 

This effect stacks until the next Runic Empowerment.
spec_nodes.name: Icy Onslaught

spec_nodes.description: Each Rune spent during Remorseless Winter increases its damage by 10%, and extends its duration by 0.5 sec.
spec_nodes.name: Gathering Storm

spec_nodes.description: Consuming the Killing Machine effect has a 20% chance to grant you 1 Rune.
spec_nodes.name: Murderous Efficiency

spec_nodes.description: Frost Strike and Glacial Advance have a 15% increased chance to trigger Rime and Howling Blast generates 8 Runic Power while Rime is active.
spec_nodes.name: Rage of the Frozen Champion

spec_nodes.description: When Pillar of Frost expires, your Strength is increased by 8% for 6 sec. This effect lasts 2 sec longer, up to 20 sec, for each Obliterate and Frostscythe critical strike during Pillar of Frost.
spec_nodes.name: Enduring Strength

spec_nodes.description:
Pillar of Frost now summons a Remorseless Winter that lasts 4 sec longer.

Each enemy Remorseless Winter damages grants you 5% Mastery, up to 26% for 15 sec.
spec_nodes.name: Frozen Dominion

spec_nodes.description: Runic Empowerment has a 25% chance to refund 1 additional Rune.
spec_nodes.name: Frigid Executioner

spec_nodes.description: Rime empowered Howling Blast unleashes 2 icy blades at its target that deal 8 Frost damage and have 15% chance to grant Killing Machine.
spec_nodes.name: Howling Blades

spec_nodes.description: When Howling Blast consumes Rime, 15% of the damage it deals is gathered into the next cast of Remorseless Winter, up to 20 times.
spec_nodes.name: Cryogenic Chamber

spec_nodes.description: Summons a frostwyrm who breathes on all enemies within 40 yd in front of you, dealing 103 Frost damage, stunning enemies for 3 sec, and slowing movement speed by 50% for 10 sec.
spec_nodes.name: Frostwyrm's Fury

spec_nodes.description:
Rime empowered Howling Blast deals 50% increased damage to secondary targets.

Remorseless Winter deals 6% increased damage to enemies it hits, stacking up to 10 times.
spec_nodes.name: Everfrost

spec_nodes.description:
Howling Blast now hits an additional target with maximum effectiveness. 

Rime increases Howling Blast damage done by an additional 75%.
spec_nodes.name: Northwinds

spec_nodes.description: Consuming Killing Machine grants 1% critical strike chance for 10 sec, stacking up to 5 times. At 5 stacks your next Killing Machine consumes the stacks and grants you 10% increased Frost damage for 10 sec.
spec_nodes.name: Bonegrinder

spec_nodes.description:
Your auto attack damage is increased by 10%. 

This amount is increased for each stack of Icy Talons you have and it can stack up to 2 additional times.
spec_nodes.name: Smothering Offense

spec_nodes.description: Casting Howling Blast with Rime active causes jagged icicles to fall on enemies nearby your target, applying Razorice and dealing 7 Frost damage.
spec_nodes.name: Avalanche

spec_nodes.description: When empowered by Rime, Howling Blast deals 30% increased damage to your primary target.
spec_nodes.name: Icebreaker

spec_nodes.description:
During Pillar of Frost, Frost Strike and Howling Blast always grant Killing Machine and have a 20% chance to generate a Rune.

Additionally during Pillar of Frost, Empower Rune Weapon causes your next Obliterate or Frostscythe to cost no Runes.
spec_nodes.name: Obliteration

spec_nodes.description: Your auto attack critical strikes have a chance to send out a torrent of ice dealing 49 Frost damage to enemies in front of you.
spec_nodes.name: Icy Death Torrent

spec_nodes.description:
When Frost Strike damages an enemy with 5 stacks of Razorice it will consume them to deal an additional 115% damage.

Frostbane consumes the Razorice on your main target to deal an additional 300% damage.
spec_nodes.name: Shattering Blade

spec_nodes.description: Your Runic Power spending abilities have a chance to additionally deal 30% of the damage dealt over 4 sec.
spec_nodes.name: Hyperpyrexia

spec_nodes.description:
Obliterate and Frostscythe consume all Killing Machines to deal 25% increased critical strike damage and grant 1.5% Haste for 8 sec for each stack consumed.

Multiple applications may overlap.
spec_nodes.name: Killing Streak

spec_nodes.description: While Pillar of Frost is active your auto-attack critical strikes increase its duration by 1 sec, up to a maximum of 4 sec.
spec_nodes.name: The Long Winter

spec_nodes.description:
Each foe struck with Glacial Advance has a chance to transform your next Frost Strike into Frostbane. The chance increases with the number of Razorice stacks on the target.

Frostbane
Start a frozen onslaught that strikes twice, unleashing the chilling essence of winter, dealing 25 Frost damage to all enemies caught in its wake with each strike.

Each enemy struck reduces the damage dealt to the next foe by 5%, down to 40%.
spec_nodes.name: Frostbane

spec_nodes.description:
Call upon Sindragosa's aid in battle for 8 sec, continuously dealing 38 Frost damage every 1 sec to enemies in a cone in front of you. Consuming Killing Machine or Rime increases the duration by 0.8 sec. Deals reduced damage to secondary targets.

Grants a charge of Empower Rune Weapon at the start and 2 Runes at the end.
spec_nodes.name: Breath of Sindragosa

spec_nodes.description: Frostwyrm's Fury deals 100% increased damage to the first enemy it hits and grants you 15% Haste for 12 sec.
spec_nodes.name: Chosen of Frostbrood

embellishments.name: Arcanoweave Lining
embellishments.stat_display: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to draw in a mana wyrm that will empower you and an ally with Arcanoweave Insight, increasing your Strength by 67 and your ally's Primary Stat by 17.

embellishments.name: Hunt
embellishments.stat_display: Equip: Your spells and abilities have the chance to grant 85 secondary stats for 15 sec based on the target creature's type.

embellishments.name: Hunter's Ritual Stone
embellishments.stat_display:
Equip: Your damaging spells and abilities have a chance to grant 101 of a random secondary stat for 15 sec.

While on a Prey Hunt this effect is increased by 50%. This bonus is only available outdoors while hunting prey.

class_talents.description: Your blood freezes, granting immunity to Stun effects and reducing all damage you take by 30% for 8 sec.
class_talents.name: Icebound Fortitude

class_talents.description: Focuses dark power into a strike that deals 4,120 Physical damage and heals you for 32.00% of all damage taken in the last 5 sec, minimum 11.2% of maximum health.
class_talents.name: Death Strike

class_talents.description: Raises a ghoul to fight by your side.  You can have a maximum of one ghoul at a time. Lasts 1 min.
class_talents.name: Raise Dead

class_talents.description: Auto attacks have a chance to generate 3 Runic Power.
class_talents.name: Runic Attenuation

class_talents.description: Death Strike's cost is reduced by 10, and its healing is increased by 60%.
class_talents.name: Improved Death Strike

class_talents.description: Scourge Strike and Festering Strike deal 10% increased damage.
class_talents.name: Cleaving Strikes

class_talents.description: Smash the target's mind with cold, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.
class_talents.name: Mind Freeze

class_talents.description:
Targets in a cone in front of you are blinded, causing them to wander disoriented for 5 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

When Blinding Sleet ends, enemies are slowed by 50% for 6 sec.
class_talents.name: Blinding Sleet

class_talents.description: Absorbs are 30% more effective on you.
class_talents.name: Gloom Ward

class_talents.description:
Embrace the power of the Shadowlands, removing all root effects and increasing your movement speed by 80% for 4 sec. Taking any action cancels the effect.

While active, your movement speed cannot be reduced below 170%.
class_talents.name: Wraith Walk

class_talents.description: Increases Haste by 4%.
class_talents.name: Unholy Momentum

class_talents.description: Successfully interrupting an enemy with Mind Freeze grants 10 Runic Power and reduces its cooldown by 3 sec.
class_talents.name: Coldthirst

class_talents.description: Your auto attack damage grants you an absorb shield equal to 35% of the damage dealt.
class_talents.name: Permafrost

class_talents.description: Stamina increased by 12%.
class_talents.name: Veteran of the Third War

class_talents.description: Create a death pact that heals you for 50% of your maximum health, but absorbs incoming healing equal to 30% of your max health for 15 sec.
class_talents.name: Death Pact

class_talents.description: Your diseases have a chance to weaken your enemy causing your attacks against them to deal 6% increased damage for 5 sec.
class_talents.name: Brittle

class_talents.description: Your Runic Power spending abilities increase your melee attack speed by 6% for 10 sec, stacking up to 3 times.
class_talents.name: Icy Talons

class_talents.description: Places an Anti-Magic Zone for 6 sec, reducing the magic damage taken by party or raid members by 15%.
class_talents.name: Anti-Magic Zone

class_talents.description: The cooldown of Death Pact is reduced by 30 sec, and you receive 50% increased healing while its healing absorb is active.
class_talents.name: Death Defiance

class_talents.description: Increases the effectiveness of your Runeforge effects by 20%.
class_talents.name: Unholy Bond

class_talents.description: Lifts the enemy target off the ground, crushing their throat with dark energy and stunning them for 5 sec.
class_talents.name: Asphyxiate

class_talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Anti-Magic Shell by 20 sec and increases its duration and amount absorbed by 40%.
class_talents.name: Anti-Magic Barrier

class_talents.description: Death and Decay reduces the movement speed of enemies within its area by 90%, decaying by 10% every sec.
class_talents.name: Grip of the Dead

class_talents.description: Damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 3%. When suffering a loss of control effect, this bonus is increased by an additional 6% for 6 sec.
class_talents.name: Suppression

class_talents.description: Increases Leech by 3%.
class_talents.name: Blood Scent

class_talents.description: Your auto-attacks reduce the target's auto-attack speed by 5% for 30 sec, stacking up to 4 times.
class_talents.name: Insidious Chill

class_talents.description: Your chance to be critically struck is reduced by 3% and your Armor is increased by 6%.
class_talents.name: Runic Protection

class_talents.description: Consuming a Rune has a chance to increase your Strength by 6% for 8 sec.
class_talents.name: Rune Mastery

class_talents.description: Damage taken below 30% Health is reduced by 35%.
class_talents.name: Will of the Necropolis

class_talents.description: Magic damage taken is reduced by 5% and the duration of harmful Magic effects against you are reduced by 35%.
class_talents.name: Null Magic

class_talents.description: Death's Advance, Death and Decay, and Death Grip have 1 additional charge.
class_talents.name: Death's Echo

hero_talents.description:
Your Death Coil, Epidemic and Death Strike have a 25% chance to make your next Scourge Strike become Vampiric Strike.

Vampiric Strike heals you for 2% of your maximum health and grants you Essence of the Blood Queen, increasing your Haste by 1.0%, up to 7.0% for 20 sec.
hero_talents.name: Vampiric Strike

hero_talents.description:
Death's Advance and Wraith Walk movement speed bonuses are increased by 10%.

Activating Death's Advance or Wraith Walk increases 4 nearby allies movement speed by 20% for 5 sec.
hero_talents.name: Vampiric Speed

hero_talents.description: Death and Decay deals its damage 100% faster.
hero_talents.name: Desecrate

hero_talents.description:
Icebound Fortitude reduces all damage you take by up to an additional 20% based on your missing health.

Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor reduces the cooldown of Icebound Fortitude by 3 sec.
hero_talents.name: Bloody Fortitude

hero_talents.description:
Essence of the Blood Queen additionally increases your Mastery by 0.2% per stack.

Dread Plague deals 10% and Virulent Plague deals 10% increased damage.
hero_talents.name: Thrill of Blood

hero_talents.description: When Vampiric Strike damages an enemy affected by your plagues, it extends the duration of the plagues by 3.0 sec, and erupts them with 30% increased effectiveness.
hero_talents.name: Infliction of Sorrow

hero_talents.description: Essence of the Blood Queen stacks 2 additional times and increases the damage of your Death Coil and Death Strike by 3%, and Epidemic by 5% per stack.
hero_talents.name: Frenzied Bloodthirst

hero_talents.description:
Dark Transformation summons a Blood Beast to attack your enemy for 10 sec.

Each time the Blood Beast attacks, it stores a portion of the damage dealt. When the Blood Beast dies, it explodes, dealing 15% of the damage accumulated to nearby enemies and healing the Death Knight for the same amount. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.
hero_talents.name: The Blood is Life

hero_talents.description: When Sudden Doom is consumed, you gain 4% Strength for 5 sec.
hero_talents.name: Visceral Strength

hero_talents.description:
Your plagues deal up to 30% increased damage based on the target's missing health.

Vampiric Strike grants maximum stacks of Clawing Shadows.
hero_talents.name: Inevitable

hero_talents.description:
Vampiric Strike and Scourge Strike cause your targets to take 1% increased Shadow damage, up to 3% for 15 sec.

Vampiric Strike benefits from Incite Terror at 400% effectiveness.
hero_talents.name: Incite Terror

hero_talents.description: You store 10% of all Shadow damage dealt into your Blood Beast to explode for additional damage when it expires.
hero_talents.name: Pact of the San'layn

hero_talents.description: Vampiric Strike increases the damage of your Lesser Ghouls by 10% for 8 sec.
hero_talents.name: Transfusion

hero_talents.description:
While Dark Transformation is active you gain Gift of the San'layn.

Gift of the San'layn increases the effectiveness of your Essence of the Blood Queen by 80%, and Vampiric Strike replaces your Scourge Strike for the duration.
hero_talents.name: Gift of the San'layn

spec_talents.description:
Inflicts the target with Dread Plague and Virulent Plague.

Dread Plague
A malicious plague that deals 25,945 Shadow damage over 18 sec. Explodes for 9,479 Shadow damage to nearby enemies and infects one when the host dies. Can only be applied to 1 host at a time.

Virulent Plague
An infectious plague that spreads to all nearby enemies, dealing 11,985 Shadow damage over 18 sec.
spec_talents.name: Outbreak

spec_talents.description:
An unholy strike that deals 7,795 Shadow damage and causing your plagues on the target to erupt, dealing their damage an additional time at 35% effectiveness.

Applies Virulent Plague or spreads it to a nearby enemy.
spec_talents.name: Scourge Strike

spec_talents.description: Dread Plague has a 35% chance to exhilarate you, making your next Death Coil or Epidemic cost 15 less Runic Power and deal 35% increased damage.
spec_talents.name: Sudden Doom

spec_talents.description:
Shadows guide your strikes, increasing the damage of your Scourge Strike by 25%, and causing it to grant you Clawing Shadows up to 4 times.

For each stack of Clawing Shadows, your Scourge Strike chains to an additional enemy. Each subsequent chain deals 10% reduced damage.
spec_talents.name: Clawing Shadows

spec_talents.description: Summon a Lesser Ghoul to strike the enemy for 10,173 Shadow damage and have them explode for 7,104 Shadow damage to nearby enemies.
spec_talents.name: Putrefy

spec_talents.description:
Corrupt and evolve your Ghoul into a Monstrosity, greatly empowering its abilities for 15 sec.

Death Coil and Epidemic extends the duration of this effect by 1.0 sec.
spec_talents.name: Dark Transformation

spec_talents.description: Your diseases deal 10% more damage and have a 5% increased chance to critically strike.
spec_talents.name: Foul Infections

spec_talents.description: Critical strike damage of your minions is increased by 15%
spec_talents.name: Grave Mastery

spec_talents.description: When your Lesser Ghouls expire, they explode in viscera, dealing 2,296 Shadow damage to enemies nearby.
spec_talents.name: Necromancer's Cunning

spec_talents.description: Plagues deal 15% more damage over time in 75% of their duration.
spec_talents.name: Ebon Fever

spec_talents.description:
Festering Strike now follows up with a Festering Scythe that costs no Runes.

Festering Scythe
Slashes through all enemies within 14 yds in front of you, dealing 4,725 Shadow damage and hastening all of your plagues on targets hit to deal damage 35% faster for 25 sec.
spec_talents.name: Festering Scythe

spec_talents.description: Dark Transformation and Army of the Dead summon a Magus of the Dead who hurls Frostbolts and Shadow Bolts at your foes for 15 sec.
spec_talents.name: Magus of the Dead

spec_talents.description: The infected claws of your ghouls have a chance to sicken the foe, dealing 844 Shadow damage over 9 sec. When reapplied, any remaining damage is added to the new effect.
spec_talents.name: Infected Claws

spec_talents.description:
Putrefy reduces the cooldown of Death and Decay by 1.0 sec.

Death and Decay reduces the cooldown of Putrefy by 0.3 sec for each enemy it damages, up to 3.0 sec.
spec_talents.name: Cycle of Death

spec_talents.description: Death Coil deals 10% increased damage and causes the target to take an additional 30% of the direct damage dealt over 4 sec.
spec_talents.name: Coil of Devastation

spec_talents.description:
Summon or empower Lesser Ghouls to form an unholy army of 8 for 30 sec. While active, summoning a Lesser Ghoul will instead execute Orders based on nearby enemies.

 Death Orders
Lesser Ghouls strike with you, dealing 1,040 Shadow damage to your target.

 Epidemic Orders
Lesser Ghouls erupt in viscera, dealing 340 Shadow damage to nearby enemies. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.
spec_talents.name: Army of the Dead

spec_talents.description:

 Void Metamorphosis
Requires 35 Soul Fragments

You ascend to a higher state of being, substantially empowering your abilities.

While in Void Metamorphosis, your Consume and Reap are enhanced and your Fury will slowly drain. Additionally, Void Ray reduces your Fury drain, deals increased damage, and no longer consumes Fury.

Channel an immense amount of void energy into a single, cataclysmic blast, dealing 46,416 Cosmic damage to your target and 34,010 Cosmic damage to all nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

While casting Collapsing Star, your Fury drain is significantly reduced.

Increase all damage dealing allies' primary stat by 8.0% of your own and increase your own damage by 20% for 11.8 sec.

Ebon Might will split its effect when applied to more than 2 other allies.

Eruption, Breath of Eons, and your empower spells extend the duration of these effects.
spec_talents.name: Ebon Might

spec_talents.description:
Cause a violent eruption beneath an enemy's feet, dealing 11,308 Volcanic damage split between them and nearby enemies.

Increases the duration of your active Ebon Might effects by 1.0 sec.
spec_talents.name: Eruption

spec_talents.description: Your Living Flame has a 20% chance, and your Azure Strike has a 15% chance, to make your next Eruption cost no Essence. Stacks 2 times.
spec_talents.name: Essence Burst

spec_talents.name: Quell

spec_talents.description: Essence Burst stacks 2 times.

spec_talents.description: When cast at an enemy, Living Flame strikes 1 additional enemy for 100% damage.
spec_talents.name: Pupil of Alexstrasza

Gather earthen power beneath your enemy's feet and send them hurtling upwards, dealing 17,374 Volcanic damage to the target and nearby enemies.

Increases the duration of your active Ebon Might effects by 2 sec.

Empowering expands the area of effect.

I:   3 yd radius.

II:  6 yd radius.

III: 9 yd radius.
spec_talents.name: Upheaval

spec_talents.description:
Fly to the targeted location, exposing a Temporal Wound on enemies in your path for 11.8 sec and granting Ebon Might for 5 sec.

Removes roots and grants immunity to movement impairing and loss of control effects while flying.

 Temporal Wound
15% of damage dealt by allies affected by Ebon Might is copied as additional Arcane damage to enemies after 11.8 sec.

Damage is reduced if Ebon Might affects more than 2 other allies.
spec_talents.name: Breath of Eons

spec_talents.description:
Fatal attacks are diverted into a nearby timeline, preventing the damage, and your death, in this one.

The release of temporal energy restores 210,115 health to you, and 69,823 to 4 nearby allies, over 9 sec. Healing starts high and declines over the duration.

May only occur once every 5 min.

spec_talents.description: Increases your maximum Essence to 6.

spec_talents.description: Eruption's Essence cost is reduced by 1.
spec_talents.name: Volcanism

spec_talents.description: When allies deal damage with Temporal Wounds, they gain a shield for 100% of the damage dealt. Absorption cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health.

spec_talents.description: Defy Fate healing increased by 100% and its cooldown is reduced by 1 min.

Black Attunement: You and your 4 nearest allies have 2% increased maximum health.

Bronze Attunement:You and your 4 nearest allies have 10% increased movement speed.

class_talents.description:
Shields you in flame, absorbing 246,151 damage for 1 min.

Melee attacks against you cause the attacker to take 687 Fire damage.
class_talents.name: Blazing Barrier

class_talents.description: Alters the fabric of time, returning you to your current location and health when cast a second time, or after 10 sec. Effect negated by long distance or death.
class_talents.name: Alter Time

class_talents.description:
Encases you in a block of ice, protecting you from all attacks and damage for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

Causes Hypothermia, preventing you from recasting Ice Block for 30 sec.
class_talents.name: Ice Block

class_talents.description: Alter Time resets the cooldown of Blink and Shimmer when you return to your original location.
class_talents.name: Time Walk

class_talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Alter Time by 20 sec.
class_talents.name: Master of Time

class_talents.description: The cooldown of Ice Block is reduced by 60 sec.
class_talents.name: Winter's Protection

class_talents.description: Reduces magic damage taken by 8%.
class_talents.name: Arcane Warding

class_talents.description: Arcane Intellect grants you an additional 2% Intellect.
class_talents.name: Inspired Intellect

class_talents.description:
Creates 3 copies of you nearby for 15 sec, which cast spells and attack your enemies. While active, you generate significantly reduced threat.

Taking direct damage will cause one of your images to dissipate.
class_talents.name: Mirror Image

class_talents.description: Steals a beneficial magic effect from the target. This effect lasts a maximum of 2 min.
class_talents.name: Spellsteal

class_talents.description: Counterspell's cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.
class_talents.name: Quick Witted

class_talents.description: Pulses arcane energy around the target enemy or ally, dealing 1,466 Arcane damage to all enemies within 8 yds, and knocking them upward. A primary enemy target will take 100% increased damage.
class_talents.name: Supernova

class_talents.description: Removes all Curses from a friendly target.
class_talents.name: Remove Curse

class_talents.description: Teleports you 20 yds forward, unless something is in the way. Unaffected by the global cooldown and castable while casting.
class_talents.name: Shimmer

class_talents.description:
Each time your Fireball fails to critically strike, it gains 20% increased critical strike chance.

Critical strike bonus is removed when the affected spell critically strikes.
class_talents.name: Overflowing Energy

class_talents.description: Makes you invisible and untargetable for 20 sec, removing all threat. Any action taken cancels this effect.
class_talents.name: Greater Invisibility

class_talents.description: The duration of Hot Streak is increased by 15 sec.
class_talents.name: Captured Thoughts

class_talents.description: Increases critical strike chance by 2%.
class_talents.name: Tome of Rhonin

class_talents.description: Damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 4%.
class_talents.name: Improved Warding

class_talents.description: Increases Haste by 2%.
class_talents.name: Tome of Antonidas

class_talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Invisibility by 60 sec.
class_talents.name: Master of Escape

class_talents.description: The critical strike damage of your spells is increased by 5%.
class_talents.name: Charm of Aegwynn

class_talents.description: Gaining Hot Streak increases your Intellect by 1% for 8 sec. Multiple instances may overlap.
class_talents.name: Brainstorm

class_talents.description: The cooldowns of Blink and Shimmer are reduced by 3 sec.
class_talents.name: Flow of Time

class_talents.description: Your Mastery is increased by 3%.
class_talents.name: Charm of Medivh

class_talents.description: The cooldown of Ice Block and Ice Cold are reduced by 30 sec.
class_talents.name: Permafrost Bauble

class_talents.description: The cooldowns of your loss of control spells are reduced by 5 sec.
class_talents.name: Time Manipulation

class_talents.description: Casting your barrier removes all snare effects.
class_talents.name: Energized Barriers

class_talents.description: When your Barrier is removed, reduce its cooldown by 5 sec.
class_talents.name: Barrier Diffusion

class_talents.description: Ice Block now reduces all damage taken by 70% for 6 sec but no longer grants Immunity, prevents movement, attacks, or casting spells. Does not incur the Global Cooldown.
class_talents.name: Ice Cold

class_talents.description: Shimmer gains an additional charge.
class_talents.name: Spatial Manipulation

class_talents.description: Blazing Barrier gains an additional charge and cauterizes your wounds, healing you for 15% of the damage it absorbs.
class_talents.name: Improved Blazing Barrier

hero_talents.description:
Consuming Hot Streak has a 24% chance to conjure a Spellfire Sphere.

While you're out of combat, you will slowly conjure Spellfire Spheres over time.

 Spellfire Sphere
Increases your spell damage by 2.0%. Stacks up to 3 times.
hero_talents.name: Spellfire Spheres

hero_talents.description: Consuming Hot Streak grants you 0.5% Haste for 6 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.
hero_talents.name: Mana Cascade

hero_talents.description:
When you cast Combustion, summon an Arcane Phoenix to aid you in battle.

  Arcane Phoenix
Your Arcane Phoenix aids you for the duration of your Combustion, casting random Arcane and Fire spells.
hero_talents.name: Invocation: Arcane Phoenix

hero_talents.description:
Pyroblast damage increased by 3%.

Flamestrike damage increased by 3%.
hero_talents.name: Burden of Power

hero_talents.description:
Generating a Spellfire Sphere causes your next cast of Fire Blast to call down a storm of 4 Meteorites on its target.

 Meteorite
Calls down a meteorite which lands at the target location after 3 sec, dealing 4,891 Fire damage to all enemies hit, reduced beyond 8 targets.
hero_talents.name: Glorious Incandescence

hero_talents.description:
The bonuses provided by your Barrier spells persist at 100% effectiveness for an additional 8 sec after your Barrier is removed.

Additionally, Cauterize no longer deals damage to you.
hero_talents.name: Merely a Setback

hero_talents.description:
When your Arcane Phoenix is summoned, it consumes all your Spellfire Spheres.

Each Sphere consumed increases your spell damage during Combustion by 2% and causes your Arcane Phoenix to cast an exceptional Arcane or Fire spell over its duration.
hero_talents.name: Codex of the Sunstriders

hero_talents.description: After casting Combustion, your next Shimmer will cause a Blast Wave at your previous location, dealing 2,541 Fire damage, knocking enemies back 8 yds, and slowing them by 70% for 6 sec.
hero_talents.name: Explosive Potential

hero_talents.description:
Damage from Fireball has a 20% chance to summon a Meteorite.

When a Meteorite lands, the cooldown of Fire Blast is reduced by 0.5 sec.
hero_talents.name: Pyrocosm

hero_talents.description: Pyroclasm's damage bonus is increased by 20% and Meteor grants Pyroclasm if talented.
hero_talents.name: Sunfury Execution

hero_talents.description:
Each time your Phoenix casts a spell, gain 1 stack of Mana Cascade.

Exceptional spells grant 1 additional stack.
hero_talents.name: Ashes of Inspiration

hero_talents.description:
Your chance to generate a Spellfire Sphere is increased by 12%.

Spellfire Spheres grant an additional 1% spell damage.
hero_talents.name: Rondurmancy

hero_talents.description:
Fire Blast cooldown reduced by 1.0 sec.

Meteorite damage increased by 15%.
hero_talents.name: Spellfire Salvo

hero_talents.description:
When your Arcane Phoenix expires it empowers you, granting Hyperthermia for 4.0 sec.

 Hyperthermia:
Pyroblast and Flamestrike have no cast time, are guaranteed to critically strike, and increase the damage of Pyroblast and Flamestrike by 15%.
hero_talents.name: Memory of Al'ar

spec_talents.description: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 31,228 Fire damage.
spec_talents.name: Pyroblast

spec_talents.description:
Blasts the enemy, critically striking for 13,606 Fire damage.

Castable while casting other spells.
spec_talents.name: Fire Blast

spec_talents.description: Your Fireball and Pyroblast spells always deal a critical strike when the target is above 90% health.
spec_talents.name: Firestarter

spec_talents.description:
Calls down a pillar of fire, burning all enemies within the area for 17,024 Fire damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

This spell is cast at a selected location.
spec_talents.name: Flamestrike

spec_talents.description:
Fire Blast now spreads 50% of your target's Ignite to 1 enemy.

Flamestrike applies 15% more Ignite.
spec_talents.name: Ignition

spec_talents.description:
Engulfs you in flames for 10 sec, increasing your spells' critical strike chance by 100%.

Additionally, increases your spell damage by 10% plus an additional 20% of your critical strike chance.

Castable while casting other spells.
spec_talents.name: Combustion

spec_talents.description:
Flamestrike has a chance equal to 100% of your spell critical strike chance to build up to a Hot Streak.

Flamestrike deals 5% increased damage for each enemy it damages, up to 25%.
spec_talents.name: Fuel the Fire

spec_talents.description: Fire Blast gains 1 additional charge and its damage is increased by 25%.
spec_talents.name: Fervent Flickering

spec_talents.description:
Fatal damage instead brings you to 35% health and then burns you for 28% of your maximum health over 6 sec.

While burning, movement slowing effects are suppressed and your movement speed is increased by 150%.

This effect cannot occur more than once every 6 min.
spec_talents.name: Cauterize

spec_talents.description:
Calls down a meteor which lands at the target location after 3 sec, dealing 41,621 Fire damage to all enemies, and burns the ground, dealing 19,727 Fire damage over 4 sec to all enemies in the area.

The enemy closest to the center of the Meteor's impact takes 75% increased damage. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
spec_talents.name: Meteor

spec_talents.description:
Scorches an enemy for 4,755 Fire damage.

When cast on a target below 30% health, Scorch is a guaranteed critical strike.

Castable while moving.
spec_talents.name: Scorch

spec_talents.description: Fire Blast gains 1 additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 2.0 sec.
spec_talents.name: Flame On

spec_talents.description: Combustion's cooldown is reduced by 60 sec.

class_talents.description:
Shields you with ice, absorbing 261,785 damage for 1 min.

Melee attacks against you reduce the attacker's movement speed by 50%.
class_talents.name: Ice Barrier

class_talents.description: Alters the fabric of time, returning you to your current location and health when cast a second time, or after 10 sec. Effect negated by long distance or death.
class_talents.name: Alter Time

class_talents.description:
Encases you in a block of ice, protecting you from all attacks and damage for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

Causes Hypothermia, preventing you from recasting Ice Block for 20 sec.
class_talents.name: Ice Block

class_talents.description: Upon dropping below 25% health, your past self corrects your timeline, casting Alter Time and instantly returning 20% of your maximum health and healing you for an additional 30% over 6 sec.
class_talents.name: Temporal Realignment

class_talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Temporal Realignment by 20 sec.
class_talents.name: Master of Time

class_talents.description: The cooldown of Ice Block is reduced by 60 sec.
class_talents.name: Winter's Protection

class_talents.description: Hypothermia's duration is reduced by 10 sec.
class_talents.name: Frost Conditioning

class_talents.description: Reduces magic damage taken by 8%.
class_talents.name: Arcane Warding

class_talents.description: Arcane Intellect grants you an additional 2% Intellect.
class_talents.name: Inspired Intellect

class_talents.description:
Creates 3 copies of you nearby for 15 sec, which cast spells and attack your enemies. While active, you generate significantly reduced threat.

Taking direct damage will cause one of your images to dissipate.
class_talents.name: Mirror Image

class_talents.description: Steals a beneficial magic effect from the target. This effect lasts a maximum of 2 min.
class_talents.name: Spellsteal

class_talents.description: Counterspell's cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.
class_talents.name: Quick Witted

class_talents.description: Pulses arcane energy around the target enemy or ally, dealing 1,288 Arcane damage to all enemies within 8 yds, and knocking them upward. A primary enemy target will take 100% increased damage.
class_talents.name: Supernova

class_talents.description: Removes all Curses from a friendly target.
class_talents.name: Remove Curse

class_talents.description: Teleports you 20 yds forward, unless something is in the way. Unaffected by the global cooldown and castable while casting.
class_talents.name: Shimmer

class_talents.description:
Each time your Frostbolt fails to critically strike, it gains 10% increased critical strike chance.

Critical strike bonus is removed when the affected spell critically strikes.
class_talents.name: Overflowing Energy

class_talents.description: Makes you invisible and untargetable for 20 sec, removing all threat. Any action taken cancels this effect.
class_talents.name: Greater Invisibility

class_talents.description: The duration of Brain Freeze is increased by 15 sec.
class_talents.name: Captured Thoughts

class_talents.description: Increases critical strike chance by 2%.
class_talents.name: Tome of Rhonin

class_talents.description: Damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 4%.
class_talents.name: Improved Warding

class_talents.description: Increases Haste by 2%.
class_talents.name: Tome of Antonidas

class_talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Invisibility by 60 sec.
class_talents.name: Master of Escape

class_talents.description: The critical strike damage of your spells is increased by 5%.
class_talents.name: Charm of Aegwynn

class_talents.description: Gaining Brain Freeze increases your Intellect by 1% for 8 sec. Multiple instances may overlap.
class_talents.name: Brainstorm

class_talents.description: The cooldowns of Blink and Shimmer are reduced by 3 sec.
class_talents.name: Flow of Time

class_talents.description: Your Mastery is increased by 3%.
class_talents.name: Charm of Medivh

class_talents.description: The cooldown of Ice Block and Ice Cold are reduced by 30 sec.
class_talents.name: Permafrost Bauble

class_talents.description: Casting your barrier removes all snare effects.
class_talents.name: Energized Barriers

class_talents.description: When your Barrier is removed, reduce its cooldown by 5 sec.
class_talents.name: Barrier Diffusion

class_talents.description: Ice Block now reduces all damage taken by 70% for 6 sec but no longer grants Immunity, prevents movement, attacks, or casting spells. Does not incur the Global Cooldown.
class_talents.name: Ice Cold

class_talents.description: Shimmer gains an additional charge.
class_talents.name: Spatial Manipulation

class_talents.description: Ice Barrier gains an additional charge and reduces your physical damage taken by 10%.
class_talents.name: Improved Ice Barrier

hero_talents.description:
Casting Frostbolt or Flurry conjures a Frost Splinter.

Frost Splinter:
Conjure raw Frost magic into a sharp projectile that deals 2,466 Frost damage.
hero_talents.name: Splintering Sorcery

hero_talents.description: Conjuring one or more Frost Splinters has a 10% chance to conjure a burst of 8 Frost Splinters.
hero_talents.name: Augury Abounds

hero_talents.description: Ice Lance conjures a Frost Splinter for every 2 Freezing stacks Shattered from its primary target.
hero_talents.name: Force of Will

hero_talents.description:
Enemies damaged by your Frozen Orb conjure 1 Frost Splinter, up to 4.

Frozen Orb damage is increased by 40%.
hero_talents.name: Splintering Orbs

hero_talents.description: Gaining Brain Freeze conjures 2 Frost Splinters.
hero_talents.name: Shifting Shards

hero_talents.description: You have 40% increased movement speed during Alter Time.
hero_talents.name: Slippery Slinging

hero_talents.description: 60% of the direct damage dealt by a Frost Splinter is also dealt to nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
hero_talents.name: Controlled Instincts

hero_talents.description:
Your Ice Barrier can absorb up to 25% more damage based on your missing health.

Max effectiveness when under 25% health.
hero_talents.name: Reactive Barrier

hero_talents.description: Direct damage from Frost Splinters have a 15% chance to apply 1 stack of Freezing.
hero_talents.name: Infused Splinters

hero_talents.description:
Ray of Frost damage increased by 20%.

Your chance to gain Brain Freeze from Frostbolt is increased by 5%.
hero_talents.name: Archmage's Wrath

hero_talents.description:
Frostbolt and Blizzard damage increased by 25%.

Glacial Spike conjures 2 additional Frost Splinters.
hero_talents.name: Signature Spell

hero_talents.description: Direct damage from Frost Splinters reduces the cooldown of Frozen Orb by 0.30 sec.
hero_talents.name: Spellfrost Teachings

hero_talents.description:
Ice Lance Shatters 1 additional stack of Freezing.

Shatter damage increased by 20%.
hero_talents.name: Polished Focus

hero_talents.description:
Each time Ray of Frost damages one or more enemies, it generates 1 Frost Splinter.

For 10 sec after casting Ray of Frost, your chance to conjure an additional Frost Splinter is increased to 100%.
hero_talents.name: Splinterstorm

spec_talents.description:
Quickly fling a shard of ice at the target, dealing 9,997 Frost damage.

Shatters 6 stacks of Freezing.
spec_talents.name: Ice Lance

spec_talents.description:
Ice shards pelt the target area, dealing 31,508 Frost damage over 9.4 sec and reducing movement speed by 50% for 3 sec.

This spell is cast at a selected location
spec_talents.name: Blizzard

spec_talents.description:
Frostbolt has a 18% chance to grant a charge of Fingers of Frost.

Fingers of Frost causes your next Ice Lance to deal Shatter damage equal to 6 stacks of Freezing and does not consume Freezing stacks.

Maximum 2 charges.
spec_talents.name: Fingers of Frost

spec_talents.description:
When Frostbolt critically strikes, it applies 1 additional stack of Freezing.

Each stack of Freezing that you Shatter deals 1,701 damage to nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
spec_talents.name: Frostbite

spec_talents.description:
While in combat, Frost crystallizes around you, generating an Icicle every 4.7 sec. Upon generating 5 Icicles, Frostbolt upgrades to Glacial Spike for its next cast.

 Glacial Spike
Conjures a massive spike of ice that impales your target, dealing 107,966 damage and slowing the target's movement speed by 50% for 8 sec.

Applies 3 stacks of Freezing.
spec_talents.name: Icicles

spec_talents.description:
Unleash a flurry of ice, striking the target 4 times for a total of 33,713 Frost damage.

Applies 4 stacks of Freezing.
spec_talents.name: Flurry

spec_talents.description: Ice Block now has an additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.
spec_talents.name: Glacial Bulwark

spec_talents.description:
Launches an orb of swirling ice in front of you, dealing up to 100,753 Frost damage to all enemies it passes through over 15 sec. After a short delay, Frozen Orb will pursue its target. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

Enemies damaged by the Frozen Orb are slowed by 50% for 8 sec.
spec_talents.name: Frozen Orb

spec_talents.description: Frostbolt has a 36% chance to reset the remaining cooldown on Flurry and cause your next Flurry to deal 50% increased damage.
spec_talents.name: Brain Freeze

spec_talents.description:
Channel an icy beam at the enemy for 3.1 sec, dealing 36,757 Frost damage every 0.39 sec.

Applies 8 stacks of Freezing over its duration.
spec_talents.name: Ray of Frost

spec_talents.description:
Casting Frozen Orb grants 1 stack of Fingers of Frost.

Damaging one or more enemies with Frozen Orb has a 3% chance to grant Fingers of Frost.
spec_talents.name: Everlasting Frost

spec_talents.description: Frozen Orb increases Shatter's damage by 10% for its duration.
spec_talents.name: Permafrost Lances

spec_talents.description: Frostbolt grants you Fingers of Frost 25% more often and Brain Freeze 20% more often.
spec_talents.name: Frozen Touch

spec_talents.description: Your Flurry and Frostbolt spells strike 1 additional target at 50% effectiveness.
spec_talents.name: Splitting Ice

spec_talents.description: Casting Glacial Spike has a 100% chance to grant you Fingers of Frost.
spec_talents.name: Flash Freeze

spec_talents.description: Ray of Frost deals 30% of its damage to 5 nearby enemies.
spec_talents.name: Splintering Ray

spec_talents.description:
Your Haste is increased by 3%.

You gain 5% more Haste from all sources of Haste.
spec_talents.name: Winter's Blessing

spec_talents.description: Ice Lance strikes 1 additional target at 50% effectiveness, preferring enemies with more stacks of Freezing.
spec_talents.name: Fractured Frost

spec_talents.description: Shatter damage has a 50% increased chance to critically strike.
spec_talents.name: Improved Shatter

spec_talents.description: Shatter's critical strike damage is increased by 50% of your critical strike chance.
spec_talents.name: Deep Shatter

spec_talents.description: Frozen Orb has a 100% chance to grant Brain Freeze.
spec_talents.name: Wintertide

spec_talents.description: Flurry and Blizzard damage increased by 40%.
spec_talents.name: Glacial Attunement

spec_talents.description: Ice Lance Shatters 1 additional stack of Freezing.
spec_talents.name: Heart of Ice

spec_talents.description: Flurry fires 1 additional missile.
spec_talents.name: Improved Flurry

spec_talents.description:
Flurry has a 12% chance each hit to call down an icy comet, crashing into your target and nearby enemies for 8,168 Frost damage.

Applies 1 stack of Freezing.
spec_talents.name: Glacial Assault

spec_talents.description: Ray of Frost generates 2 stacks of Fingers of Frost over its duration.
spec_talents.name: Crystalline Refraction

spec_talents.description: Spell damage increased by 3%.
spec_talents.name: Lonely Winter

spec_talents.description: Consuming Brain Freeze has a 100% chance to cause your next Ice Lance to Shatter 6 additional stacks of Freezing.
spec_talents.name: Thermal Void

spec_talents.description: When Ice Lance Shatters a stack of Freezing, the cooldown of Ray of Frost is reduced by 0.10 sec.
spec_talents.name: Glaciate

Ray of Frost summons 4 Hands of Frost over its duration.

Ray of Frost gains an additional charge and its damage is increased by 25%.
spec_talents.name: Hand of Frost

class_talents.description: Heals the target for 56,365 over 6.9 sec. While channeling, Enveloping Mist and Vivify may be cast instantly on the target.
class_talents.name: Soothing Mist

class_talents.description: Kick upwards, dealing 27,128 Physical damage, and reducing the effectiveness of healing on the target for 10 sec.
class_talents.name: Rising Sun Kick

class_talents.description: Incapacitates the target for 1 min. Limit 1. Damage may cancel the effect.
class_talents.name: Paralysis

class_talents.description: Kick upwards, dealing 27,042 Physical damage, and reducing the effectiveness of healing on the target for 10 sec.
class_talents.name: Rising Sun Kick

class_talents.description: Reduces all damage taken by you and your target while channeling Soothing Mists by 6%.
class_talents.name: Elusive Mists

class_talents.description: Increases a friendly target's movement speed by 70% for 6 sec and removes all roots and snares.
class_talents.name: Tiger's Lust

class_talents.description: Rising Sun Kick deals 70% increased damage. Spinning Crane Kick deals 10% additional damage.
class_talents.name: Fast Feet

class_talents.description: Increases all healing taken by 4%.
class_talents.name: Grace of the Crane

class_talents.description: Reduces all damage taken by 10%.
class_talents.name: Calming Presence

class_talents.description: Removes all Poison and Disease effects from the target.
class_talents.name: Detox

class_talents.description:
After casting Rising Sun Kick, your next Vivify becomes instant cast.

This effect also reduces the energy cost of Vivify by 75%.
class_talents.name: Vivacious Vivification

class_talents.description: While out of combat, your movement speed is increased by 15%.
class_talents.name: Jade Walk

class_talents.description: Jabs the target in the throat, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 5 sec.
class_talents.name: Spear Hand Strike

class_talents.description: Your auto attack critical strike chance is increased by 15%.
class_talents.name: Tiger Fang

class_talents.description: Split your body and spirit, leaving your spirit behind for 15 min. Use Transcendence: Transfer to swap locations with your spirit.
class_talents.name: Transcendence

class_talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Roll by 5 sec and increases its maximum number of charges by 1.
class_talents.name: Celerity

class_talents.description: The duration of snare effects on you is reduced by 20%.
class_talents.name: Quick Footed

class_talents.description: Increases all damage dealt by 4%.
class_talents.name: Ferocity of Xuen

class_talents.description: Form a Ring of Peace at the target location for 5 sec. Enemies that enter will be ejected from the Ring.
class_talents.name: Ring of Peace

class_talents.description: Increases the range of Leg Sweep by 4 yds.
class_talents.name: Tiger Tail Sweep

class_talents.description: Touch of Death can now be used on targets with less than 15% health remaining, dealing 35% of your maximum health in damage.
class_talents.name: Improved Touch of Death

class_talents.description: Expel Harm's healing increased by 6% and critical strike chance increased by 15%.
class_talents.name: Vigorous Expulsion

class_talents.description: Find resilience in the flow of chi in battle, gaining a magic absorb shield for 0.6% of your max health every 3 sec in combat, stacking up to 6%.
class_talents.name: Yu'lon's Grace

class_talents.description:
Turns your skin to stone for 15 sec, increasing your current and maximum health by 20% and reducing all damage you take by 20%.

Combines with other Fortifying Brew effects.
class_talents.name: Fortifying Brew

class_talents.description: Your physical damage taken is reduced by 10% and an additional 10% every 4 sec until you receive a physical attack, stacking up to 4.
class_talents.name: Dance of the Wind

class_talents.description: Expel Harm's healing is increased by up to 100%, based on your missing health.
class_talents.name: Strength of Spirit

class_talents.description:
Activating Zenith causes you to release a powerful stomp, dealing 23,905 Nature damage to nearby enemies, reduced beyond 5 targets.

Generates 2 Chi.
class_talents.name: Zenith Stomp

class_talents.description: Fortifying Brew cooldown reduced by 30 sec.
class_talents.name: Expeditious Fortification

class_talents.description: Magical damage done increased by 4% and healing done increased by 4%.
class_talents.name: Chi Proficiency

class_talents.description: You and your allies within 10 yards have 4% increased movement speed. Stacks with other similar effects.
class_talents.name: Windwalking

class_talents.description: Increases your Physical damage done by 4% and Avoidance increased by 12%.
class_talents.name: Martial Instincts

class_talents.description: Roll causes you to become lighter than air, allowing you to double jump to dash forward a short distance once within 5 sec, but the cooldown of Roll is increased by 2 sec.
class_talents.name: Lighter Than Air

class_talents.description:
You gain a bonus effect based on your current health.

Above 90% health: Movement speed increased by 5%. This bonus stacks with similar effects.

Between 90% and 35% health: Damage taken reduced by 5%.

Below 35% health: Healing received increased by 10%.
class_talents.name: Flow of Chi

class_talents.description: Touch of Death's cooldown is reduced by 90 sec.
class_talents.name: Fatal Touch

hero_talents.description:
Summons an effigy of Xuen, the White Tiger for 20 sec. Xuen attacks your primary target, and strikes 3 enemies within 10 yards every 0.9 sec with Tiger Lightning for 918 Nature damage.

Every 4 sec, Xuen strikes your enemies with Empowered Tiger Lightning dealing 4% of the damage you have dealt to those targets in the last 4 sec.
hero_talents.name: Invoke Xuen, the White Tiger

hero_talents.description: Fists of Fury and Spinning Crane Kick deal 30% more damage.
hero_talents.name: Temple Training

hero_talents.description:
Tiger Palm has a chance to cause Xuen to claw your target for 11,525 Physical damage, healing a nearby ally for 25% of the damage done.

Invoke Xuen, the White Tiger guarantees your next cast activates this effect.
hero_talents.name: Courage of the White Tiger

hero_talents.description: Invoke Xuen, the White Tiger's damage is increased by 30% and its cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.
hero_talents.name: Xuen's Bond

hero_talents.description:
Strike of the Windlord and Whirling Dragon Punch call upon Yu'lon to increase the cooldown recovery rate of Fists of Fury, Strike of the Windlord, Rising Sun Kick, and Whirling Dragon Punch by 75% for 6 sec. 

The channel time of Fists of Fury is reduced by 50% while Yu'lon is active.
hero_talents.name: Heart of the Jade Serpent

hero_talents.description: Your movement speed is increased by 75% during Celestial Conduit and by 15% for 3 sec after being assisted by any Celestial.
hero_talents.name: Chi-Ji's Swiftness

hero_talents.description: After Xuen assists you, your next Blackout Kick refunds 2 stacks of Teachings of the Monastery and causes Niuzao to stomp at your target's location, dealing 6,830 damage to nearby enemies, reduced beyond 5 targets.
hero_talents.name: Strength of the Black Ox

hero_talents.description:
Celestial Conduit's healing and damage is increased by 100% when striking a single target.

Each addtional target reduces this bonus by 20%.
hero_talents.name: Path of the Falling Star

hero_talents.description: Heart of the Jade Serpent additionally triggers for 4 sec at 100% effectiveness after you cast Zenith.
hero_talents.name: Yu'lon's Avatar

hero_talents.description: Fortifying Brew grants you an absorb shield for 25% of your maximum health.
hero_talents.name: Niuzao's Protection

hero_talents.description:
After Invoking Xuen, the White Tiger you may cast Celestial Conduit within 1 min.

 Celestial Conduit:
The August Celestials empower you, causing you to radiate 27,837 Nature damage onto enemies and 3,747 healing onto up to 5 injured allies within 15 yds over 3.4 sec, reduced beyond 5 targets.

You may move while channeling, but casting other healing or damaging spells cancels this effect.
hero_talents.name: Celestial Conduit

hero_talents.description:
You switch between alignments every 8 sec, increasing a corresponding secondary stat by 2%.

Crane Stance:
Haste

Tiger Stance:
Critical Strike

Ox Stance:
Versatility

Serpent Stance: 
Mastery
hero_talents.name: Inner Compass

hero_talents.description: Heart of the Jade Serpent increases your haste by 10% while active.
hero_talents.name: Flowing Wisdom

hero_talents.description:
Celestial Conduit can be recast once during its duration to call upon all of the August Celestials to assist you at 200% effectiveness.

Unity Within is automatically cast when Celestial Conduit ends if not used before expiration.
hero_talents.name: Unity Within

spec_talents.description: Pummels all targets in front of you, dealing 62,529 Physical damage to your primary target and 37,517 damage to all other enemies over 3.4 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets. Can be channeled while moving.
spec_talents.name: Fists of Fury

spec_talents.description:
Fists of Fury's damage is increased by 100% of your haste and Fists of Fury does 10% more damage each time it deals damage, resetting when Fists of Fury ends.

Your auto attack speed is increased by 60% for 8 sec after Fists of Fury ends.
spec_talents.name: Momentum Boost

spec_talents.description:
While out of combat, your Chi balances to 2 instead of depleting to empty.

Your stamina is increased by 5% and every 15 sec, your next Tiger Palm also casts Expel Harm.

 Expel Harm
Expel negative chi from your body, healing for 26,874 and dealing 10% of the amount healed as Nature damage to an enemy within 20 yards.
spec_talents.name: Combat Wisdom

spec_talents.description: Blackout Kick reduces the cooldown of Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury by 1.0 sec.
spec_talents.name: Sharp Reflexes

spec_talents.description: Critical Strike chance increased by 4%. This effect is increased by 100% while Xuen, the White Tiger is active.
spec_talents.name: Ferociousness

spec_talents.description: Increases your maximum Chi by 1, maximum Energy by 20, and your Energy regeneration by 10%.
spec_talents.name: Ascension

spec_talents.description: Your auto attacks have a 30% chance to instead kick your target dealing 16,542 Physical damage. Damage increased while using a two-handed weapon.
spec_talents.name: Dual Threat

spec_talents.description:
Tiger Palm causes your next Blackout Kick to strike an additional time dealing 4,657 Physical damage, stacking up to 4.

Blackout Kick has a 12% chance to reset the remaining cooldown on Rising Sun Kick.
spec_talents.name: Teachings of the Monastery

spec_talents.description: Rising Sun Kick has a chance equal to 100% of your haste to trigger a second time, dealing 9,614 Physical damage and restoring 1 Chi.
spec_talents.name: Glory of the Dawn

spec_talents.description: Spinning Crane Kick damage increased by 15% and its radius is increased by 15%.
spec_talents.name: Crane Vortex

spec_talents.description: Rising Sun Kick damage increased by 15% and critical strike damage increased by 12%.
spec_talents.name: Rising Star

spec_talents.description:
Chi costs are reduced by 1 and Blackout Kick reduces the cooldown of affected abilities by an additional 1 sec for 20 sec.

Activating Zenith resets the remaining cooldown on Rising Sun Kick.
spec_talents.name: Zenith

spec_talents.description: Each successive attack that triggers Combo Strikes in a row grants 1% increased damage, stacking up to 5 times.
spec_talents.name: Hit Combo

spec_talents.description: The damage of Fists of Fury is increased by 20%.
spec_talents.name: Crashing Fists

spec_talents.description: The duration of Zenith is extended by 5 sec.
spec_talents.name: Drinking Horn Cover

spec_talents.description: You have a 14% chance when you Tiger Palm to cause your next Blackout Kick to cost no Chi within 15 sec.
spec_talents.name: Combo Breaker

spec_talents.description: Spending Chi has a chance to make your next Spinning Crane Kick cost no Chi.
spec_talents.name: Dance of Chi-Ji

spec_talents.description:
Performs a devastating whirling upward strike, dealing 38,542 damage to all nearby enemies and an additional 18,196 damage to the first target struck. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

Only usable while both Fists of Fury and Rising Sun Kick are on cooldown.
spec_talents.name: Whirling Dragon Punch

spec_talents.description: When you consume Blackout Kick!, you have a 100% chance to generate 1 Chi.
spec_talents.name: Energy Burst

spec_talents.description: You have a 100% chance to gain Blackout Kick! after consuming Dance of Chi-Ji.
spec_talents.name: Sequenced Strikes

spec_talents.description: Rising Sun Kick gains 40% additional effectiveness from Mastery: Combo Strikes.
spec_talents.name: Sunfire Spiral

spec_talents.description: Strike of the Windlord and Whirling Dragon Punch have their cooldowns reduced by 5 sec and their damage is increased by 20%.
spec_talents.name: Communion With Wind

spec_talents.description: Strike of the Windlord and Whirling Dragon Punch have a 100% chance to activate Dance of Chi-Ji.
spec_talents.name: Revolving Whirl

spec_talents.description: Tiger Palm's chance to activate Blackout Kick! is increased by 75% and Tiger Palm's damage is increased by 30%.
spec_talents.name: Memory of the Monastery

spec_talents.description:
After consuming Blackout Kick!, Rising Sun Kick has a 60% chance to become Rushing Wind Kick.

Rushing Wind Kick:
Kick up a powerful gust of wind, dealing 34,563 Nature damage in a 25 yd cone to enemies in front of you, split evenly among them. Damage is increased by 6% for each target hit, up to 30%.
spec_talents.name: Rushing Wind Kick

spec_talents.description:
Rising Sun Kick critical strikes reduce the cooldown of Fists of Fury by 4 sec.

Spinning Crane Kick reduces the cooldown of Fists of Fury by 0.5 sec for each unique target struck, up to 2.5 sec.

The critical strike chance of Rising Sun Kick is increased by 20%.
spec_talents.name: Xuen's Battlegear

spec_talents.description: Your damage during Zenith is increased by 5%.
spec_talents.name: Weapon of Wind

spec_talents.description: At the end of your Fists of Fury channel, you release a Jadefire Stomp, dealing 17,040 damage to 1 enemy in front of you and increasing your movement speed by 20% for 3 sec.
spec_talents.name: Jadefire Stomp

spec_talents.description: Fists of Fury's Chi cost is reduced by 1, but its damage is reduced by 10%.
spec_talents.name: Harmonic Combo

spec_talents.description: Your melee attack speed is increased by 30%. This bonus is increased to 60% during Zenith.
spec_talents.name: Martial Agility

spec_talents.description: Jadefire Stomp now strikes 1 target, but deals 300% increased damage and healing.
spec_talents.name: Singularly Focused Jade

spec_talents.description:
Every 3 Chi spent generates Tigereye Brew. Zenith consumes up to 20 Tigereye Brew stacks to increase your critical strike chance for its duration by 1% per stack.

Generates quickly up to 10 stacks while out of combat and may generate up to a maximum of 30 stacks.
spec_talents.name: Tigereye Brew

spec_talents.description: Your spells and abilities deal 5% increased critical strike damage.
spec_talents.name: Tigereye Brew
