class_talents.description:
Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to 100% your maximum health.

Grants the target 30% increased armor for 8 sec.

Cannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.
class_talents.name: Lay on Hands

class_talents.description:
Learn Concentration Aura, Devotion Aura, and Crusader Aura:

Concentration Aura:
Interrupt and Silence effects on party and raid members within 40 yds are 30% shorter. 

 Devotion Aura:
Party and raid members within 40 yds are bolstered by their devotion, reducing damage taken by 3%.

 Crusader Aura:
Increases mounted speed by 20% for all party and raid members within 40 yds.
class_talents.name: Auras of the Resolute

class_talents.description:
During Avenging Wrath, Judgment is empowered into Hammer of Wrath.

 Hammer of Wrath
Hurls a divine hammer that strikes an enemy for 25,812 Holy damage.

Generates 1 Holy Power.
class_talents.name: Hammer of Wrath

class_talents.description: Cleanses a friendly target, removing all Poison and Disease effects.
class_talents.name: Cleanse Toxins

class_talents.description: Lay on Hands grants the target 30% increased armor for 8 sec and now ignores healing reduction effects.
class_talents.name: Empyreal Ward

class_talents.description: Hammer of Justice's cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.
class_talents.name: Fist of Justice

class_talents.description: Emits dazzling light in all directions, blinding enemies within 10 yds, causing them to wander disoriented for 6 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.
class_talents.name: Blinding Light

class_talents.description: After you spend 20 Holy Power, your next Word of Glory echoes onto a nearby ally at 30% effectiveness.
class_talents.name: Afterimage

class_talents.description:
When your health is brought below 25%, you instantly cast a free Word of Glory at 60% effectiveness on yourself.

Cannot occur more than once every 60 sec.
class_talents.name: Guided Prayer

class_talents.description: Leap atop your Charger for 5 sec, increasing movement speed by 100%. Usable while indoors or in combat.
class_talents.name: Divine Steed

class_talents.description:
Judgment causes the target to take 50% increased damage from your next Holy Power ability.

Multiple applications may overlap.
class_talents.name: Greater Judgment

class_talents.description: Divine Steed now has 2 charges.
class_talents.name: Cavalier

class_talents.description: Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to movement impairing effects for 8 sec.
class_talents.name: Blessing of Freedom

class_talents.description: Interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.
class_talents.name: Rebuke

class_talents.description:
Instantly cast Avenger's Shield on up to 5 targets within 30 yds.

Generates 1 Holy Power per target hit.
class_talents.name: Divine Toll

class_talents.description: Blessing of Freedom increases movement speed by 30%, and you gain Blessing of Freedom when cast on a friendly target.
class_talents.name: Unbound Freedom

class_talents.description: Armor increased by 20%, Stamina increased by 30% and damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 12%.
class_talents.name: Sanctified Plates

class_talents.description: Successfully interrupting an enemy with Rebuke or Avenger's Shield casts an extra Blessed Hammer.
class_talents.name: Punishment

class_talents.description:
Blesses a party or raid member, reducing their damage taken by 30%, but you suffer 100% of damage prevented.

Last 12 sec, or until transferred damage would cause you to fall below 20% health.
class_talents.name: Blessing of Sacrifice

class_talents.description: After casting Divine Toll, you instantly cast Avenger's Shield every 5 sec for 15 sec.
class_talents.name: Divine Resonance

class_talents.description:
Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to Physical damage and harmful effects for 10 sec.

Cannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.

Shares a cooldown with Blessing of Spellwarding.
class_talents.name: Blessing of Protection

class_talents.description: Your Consecration is 15% larger, and enemies within it have 50% reduced movement speed.
class_talents.name: Consecrated Ground

class_talents.description: Armor and critical strike chance increased by 4%.
class_talents.name: Holy Aegis

class_talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Blessing of Sacrifice by 60 sec.
class_talents.name: Sacrifice of the Just

class_talents.description: Holy Power spending abilities have a 15% chance to make your next Holy Power spending ability free and deal 15% increased damage and healing.
class_talents.name: Divine Purpose

class_talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Divine Shield, Ardent Defender, and Lay on Hands by 30%.
class_talents.name: Unbreakable Spirit

class_talents.description: Shield of the Righteous heals you and up to 2 nearby allies for 4,804.
class_talents.name: Lightforged Blessing

class_talents.description: Blessing of Sacrifice now removes and prevents all Poison and Disease effects.
class_talents.name: Righteous Protection

class_talents.description: Ardent Defender increases healing taken by 15% for its duration.
class_talents.name: Inspired Guard

class_talents.description:
Removing harmful effects with Divine Shield heals you for 10% for each effect removed.  This heal cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health.

Divine Shield may now be cast while Forbearance is active.
class_talents.name: Light's Revocation

class_talents.description: Shield of the Righteous grants 5% bonus armor for 4.5 sec.
class_talents.name: Faith's Armor

class_talents.description: Mastery increased by 4% and Strength increased by 4%.
class_talents.name: Seal of Might

class_talents.description: Hammer of Wrath deals up to 50% additional damage based on its target's health. Lower health targets receive more damage.
class_talents.name: Vengeful Wrath

class_talents.description: Damage taken reduced by up to 20%, increasing as your health decreases.
class_talents.name: Blessing of Dusk

hero_talents.description:
Will the Light to coalesce and become manifest as a Holy Armament, wielded by your friendly target.

 Holy Bulwark:

While wielding a Holy Bulwark, gain an absorb shield for 15.0% of your max health and an additional 2.0% every 2 sec. Lasts 20 sec.

Becomes Sacred Weapon after use.
hero_talents.name: Holy Bulwark

hero_talents.description:
Imbue your weapon with the power of the Light, increasing your armor by 5% and your primary stat by 2%.

Lasts 1 hour.
hero_talents.name: Rite of Sanctification

hero_talents.description:
If you bestow an Armament upon an ally, you also gain its benefits.

If you bestow an Armament upon yourself, a nearby ally also gains its benefits.
hero_talents.name: Solidarity

hero_talents.description:
For each Holy Power ability cast, your next Consecration deals 13,587 damage immediately, split across all enemies.

Up to 3 nearby allies are each healed for 30% of the damage amount.
hero_talents.name: Divine Guidance

hero_talents.description: After casting a Holy Armament, your next 3 casts of Blessed Hammer bestow a Lesser Armament of the same kind on a nearby ally.
hero_talents.name: Masterwork

hero_talents.description: When an Armament fades from you, the cooldown of Lay on Hands is reduced by 15.0 sec and you gain Shining Light.
hero_talents.name: Laying Down Arms

hero_talents.description: Your spells and abilities have a chance to manifest a Holy Armament for a nearby ally.
hero_talents.name: Divine Inspiration

hero_talents.description:
When you or an ally wielding a Holy Bulwark are healed above maximum health, transfer 100% of the overhealing to your ally.

When you or an ally wielding a Sacred Weapon drop below 40% health, redistribute your health immediately and every 1 sec for 4 sec. May only occur once per cast.
hero_talents.name: Tempered in Battle

hero_talents.description: Judgment critical strikes cause a shockwave around the target, dealing 7,072 damage to enemies within 5 yards. Damage reduced above 5 targets.
hero_talents.name: Hammer and Anvil

hero_talents.description: The effect of your active Aura is increased by 33% on targets with your Armaments.
hero_talents.name: Shared Resolve

hero_talents.description: Consuming Shining Light reduces the cooldown of Holy Armaments by 3.0 sec.
hero_talents.name: Valiance

hero_talents.description: When your Holy Bulwark absorbs damage or your Sacred Weapon deals damage or healing, you have a chance to gain Grand Crusader.
hero_talents.name: Reflection of Radiance

hero_talents.description: Divine Toll activates Hammer and Anvil at 100% effectiveness.
hero_talents.name: Resounding Strike

hero_talents.description: Avenging Wrath summons an additional Sacred Weapon, and during Avenging Wrath your Sacred Weapon casts spells on your target and echoes the effects of your Holy Power abilities.
hero_talents.name: Blessing of the Forge

spec_talents.description:
Hurls your shield at an enemy target, dealing 7,604 Holy damage, interrupting and silencing the non-Player target for 3 sec, and then jumping to 4 additional nearby enemies. 

Shields you for 8 sec, absorbing 75% as much damage as it dealt.
spec_talents.name: Avenger's Shield

spec_talents.description: Every 3 Shields of the Righteous make your next Word of Glory cost no Holy Power. Maximum 2 stacks.
spec_talents.name: Shining Light

spec_talents.description:
Throws a Blessed Hammer that spirals outward, dealing 1,256 Holy damage to enemies and reducing the next damage they deal to you by 1,059.

Generates 1 Holy Power.
spec_talents.name: Blessed Hammer

spec_talents.description: When you avoid a melee attack or use Blessed Hammer, you have a 15% chance to reset the remaining cooldown on Avenger's Shield.
spec_talents.name: Grand Crusader

spec_talents.description: Armor granted by Shield of the Righteous is increased by up to 60%, based on your missing health.
spec_talents.name: Redoubt

spec_talents.description:
Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to magical damage and harmful effects for 10 sec.

Cannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.

Shares a cooldown with Blessing of Protection.
spec_talents.name: Blessing of Spellwarding

spec_talents.description:
Reduces all damage you take by 30% for 12 sec.

While Ardent Defender is active, the next attack that would otherwise kill you will instead bring you to 20% of your maximum health.
spec_talents.name: Ardent Defender

spec_talents.description: Casting Avenger's Shield causes Consecration to deal its damage and healing again immediately at 100% effectiveness.
spec_talents.name: Searing Sunlight

spec_talents.description: Enemies struck by Avenger's Shield burn with holy fire, suffering 100% additional Radiant damage over 5 sec.
spec_talents.name: Refining Fire

spec_talents.description: Avenger's Shield also shields you for 8 sec, absorbing 75% as much damage as it dealt, up to 50% of your maximum health.
spec_talents.name: Bulwark of Order

spec_talents.description: Call upon the Light to become an avatar of retribution, increasing your damage, healing, and critical strike chance by 10% for 12 sec.
spec_talents.name: Avenging Wrath

spec_talents.description:
Word of Glory heals for an additional 40% over 10 sec.

Increased by 200% if cast on yourself while you are afflicted by a harmful damage over time effect.
spec_talents.name: Light of the Titans

spec_talents.description: Consecration heals you for 375% of the damage it deals.
spec_talents.name: Solace

spec_talents.description: You are healed for at least 125% of the damage dealt by Refining Fire, increasing to a maximum of 300% as your health decreases.
spec_talents.name: Undying Embers

spec_talents.description: Your haste is increased by 5%.
spec_talents.name: Relentless Inquisitor

spec_talents.description: Your Blessed Hammer causes enemies struck to deal 10% reduced damage to you for 8 sec.
spec_talents.name: Seal of Reprisal

spec_talents.description: Judgment now has 2 charges, and Grand Crusader now also reduces the cooldown of Judgment by 3 sec.
spec_talents.name: Crusader's Judgment

spec_talents.description: Avenger's Shield jumps to 2 additional targets.
spec_talents.name: Soaring Shield

spec_talents.description: Empowers you with the spirit of ancient kings, reducing all damage you take by 50% for 8 sec.
spec_talents.name: Guardian of Ancient Kings

spec_talents.description: While in your Consecration and for 4.0 sec after leaving it, your damage taken is reduced by 5%.
spec_talents.name: Sanctuary

spec_talents.description: For each target hit by Avenger's Shield, gain 3% parry for 15 sec.
spec_talents.name: Strength in Adversity

spec_talents.description:
Each enemy hit by Avenger's Shield reduces the remaining cooldown on Guardian of Ancient Kings by 1.0 sec.

When you drop below 30% health, you become infused with Guardian of Ancient Kings for 4 sec. This cannot occur again for 45 sec.
spec_talents.name: Gift of the Golden Val'kyr

spec_talents.description: Guardian of Ancient Kings has 1 additional charge.
spec_talents.name: Empyrean Authority

spec_talents.description:
Call upon the Light and gain 15 stacks of Divine Resolve, increasing your maximum health by 1% and reducing your damage taken by 2% per stack for 12 sec. After 3.0 sec, you will begin to lose 1 stack per second, but each 3 Holy Power spent will delay the loss of your next stack by 1 sec.

While active, your damage and healing are increased by 10%, and critical strike chance is increased by 10%.
spec_talents.name: Sentinel

spec_talents.description: Hammer of Wrath and Judgment deal 10% additional damage and extend the duration of Avenging Wrath by 1.0 sec.
spec_talents.name: Zealot's Paragon

spec_talents.description: Judgment chains to 2 additional targets at 50% effectiveness.
spec_talents.name: Sweeping Verdict

spec_talents.description: Avenger's Shield increases the damage of your next Shield of the Righteous by 10% for each target hit by Avenger's Shield, stacking up to 5 times, and increases its radius by 6 yds.
spec_talents.name: Bulwark of Righteous Fury

spec_talents.description: During Divine Shield, all targets within 15 yds are taunted.
spec_talents.name: Final Stand

spec_talents.description: Avenging Wrath and Sentinel have 50% reduced cooldown and 40% reduced duration.
spec_talents.name: Righteous Protector

spec_talents.description:
Your next cast of Shield of the Righteous after Vanguard deals 100% additional damage to your primary target and causes light to refract onto 4 other targets for 19,219 Holy damage.

During Avenging Wrath your Avenger's Shield always benefits from Vanguard.
spec_talents.name: Glory of the Vanguard

spec_talents.description: Judgment deals 40% increased damage. When you consume Vanguard you gain 3 Holy Power.
spec_talents.name: Glory of the Vanguard

spec_talents.description:
Judgment has a chance to grant you Vanguard, causing your next Avenger's Shield to leave an echoing bolt of light in a line between you and the initial target, piercing any enemies for up to 150% of the initial damage dealt.

Damage reduced against secondary targets.
spec_talents.name: Glory of the Vanguard

Interrupt and Silence effects on party and raid members within 40 yds are 30% shorter.

Party and raid members within 40 yds are bolstered by their devotion, reducing damage taken by 3%.

spec_nodes.description: Shadow Word: Madness causes your Shadow Word: Pain and Vampiric Touch to deal damage 40% faster on all targets for 3 sec.
spec_nodes.name: Screams of the Void

spec_nodes.description:
Your Shadow Word: Pain damage has a chance to create Shadowy Apparitions that float towards all targets afflicted by your Vampiric Touch. 

Critical strikes increase the chance by 100%.
spec_nodes.name: Tormented Spirits

spec_nodes.description: While you have Shadow Word: Pain, Shadow Word: Madness, and Vampiric Touch active on the same target, your Mind Blast, Void Torrent, Mind Flay, and Void Volley deal 13% more damage.
spec_nodes.name: Insidious Ire

spec_nodes.description:
Tentacle Slam deals 50% increased damage and Void Volley deals 15% increased damage.

When Voidform ends, you can cast Void Volley 1 additional time within 30 sec.
spec_nodes.name: Crushing Void

spec_nodes.description: While Shadowfiend, Mindbender, or Voidwraith are active, your haste is increased by 10%.
spec_nodes.name: Idol of Y'Shaarj

spec_nodes.description:
You create Horrific Visions when casting harmful spells on enemies.

At 50 stacks of Horrific Visions, your target sees a nightmare, dealing 691 Shadow damage and granting you 2 Insanity over 3 sec.

At 100 stacks, your target witnesses a vision of N'Zoth, dealing 2,618 Shadow damage and granting you 6 Insanity over 3 sec.
spec_nodes.name: Idol of N'Zoth

spec_nodes.description:
After conjuring Shadowy Apparitions, gain a stack of Idol of Yogg-Saron. At 20 stacks, you summon a Thing from Beyond that casts Void Spike at nearby enemies for 20 sec.

 Void Spike
Hurls a bolt of dark magic, dealing 357 Shadow damage and 190 Shadow damage to all enemies within 10 yards of the target. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
spec_nodes.name: Idol of Yogg-Saron

spec_nodes.description:
Mind Flay has a chance to spawn a Void Tendril that channels Mind Flay or Void Lasher that channels Mind Sear at your target.

 Mind Flay
Assaults the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 1,222 Shadow damage over 10 sec and slowing their movement speed by 30%.

Generates 5 Insanity over the duration.

 Mind Sear
Corrosive shadow energy radiates from the target, dealing 829 Shadow damage over 10 sec to all enemies within 10 yards of the target. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

Generates 5 Insanity over the duration.
spec_nodes.name: Idol of C'Thun

spec_nodes.description: When an effect from an Idol is activated, conjure Shadowy Apparitions.
spec_nodes.name: Void Apparitions

Attack with your off-hand, dealing 2,996 Physical damage, dispelling all enrage effects and applying a concentrated form of your active Non-Lethal poison.

Awards 1 combo point.
class_talents.name: Shiv

class_talents.description: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for 18 sec. Damage may interrupt the effect. Limit 1.
class_talents.name: Blind

class_talents.description: Provides a moment of magic immunity, instantly removing all harmful spell effects. The cloak lingers, causing you to resist harmful spells for 5 sec.
class_talents.name: Cloak of Shadows

class_talents.description: Shiv's Energy cost is reduced by 20, its cooldown is reduced by 15 sec, and its range is increased by 3 yds.
class_talents.name: Toxic Stiletto

class_talents.description: Movement speed increased by 15%.
class_talents.name: Fleet Footed

class_talents.description: Blind has 50% reduced cooldown, 70% reduced duration, and applies to all nearby enemies.
class_talents.name: Airborne Irritant

class_talents.description: Shadowstep has 1 additional charge.
class_talents.name: Thrill Seeking

class_talents.description: Increases the non-damaging effects of your weapon poisons by 20%.
class_talents.name: Master Poisoner

class_talents.description: Evasion also reduces damage taken by 20%, and Feint also reduces non-area-of-effect damage taken by 20%.
class_talents.name: Elusiveness

class_talents.description: Redirects all threat you cause to the targeted party or raid member, beginning with your next damaging attack within the next 30 sec and lasting 6 sec.
class_talents.name: Tricks of the Trade

class_talents.description: Energy cost of Feint and Crimson Vial reduced by 10.
class_talents.name: Nimble Fingers

class_talents.description: Physical damage taken reduced by 5%.
class_talents.name: Deadened Nerves

class_talents.description: Increases your Agility by 3%.
class_talents.name: Quick Fingers

class_talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Sprint by 60 sec.
class_talents.name: Improved Sprint

class_talents.description: Increases your dodge chance by 100% for 10 sec.
class_talents.name: Evasion

class_talents.description: Increases the healing you receive from Crimson Vial, healing potions, and healthstones by 25%.
class_talents.name: Iron Stomach

class_talents.description: Increases the damage of your weapon poisons by 10%.
class_talents.name: Virulent Poisons

class_talents.description: Feint has 1 additional charge.
class_talents.name: Graceful Guile

class_talents.description: Coats your weapons with a Non-Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 21% chance of poisoning the enemy, reducing their damage by 4.8% for 1 min.
class_talents.name: Atrophic Poison

class_talents.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your attacks that generate combo points by 5%.
class_talents.name: Deadly Precision

class_talents.description: Your finishing moves deal 6% increased damage.
class_talents.name: Deep Cuts

class_talents.description: You have a 20% chance to partially evade any damage dealt to you, reducing the damage it deals by 20%.
class_talents.name: Danger Sense

class_talents.description: Slice and Dice grants additional attack speed equal to 100% of your Haste.
class_talents.name: Swift Slasher

class_talents.description: Energy cost of finishing moves reduced by 6%.
class_talents.name: Tight Spender

class_talents.description: Adds a Leeching effect to your Lethal poisons, granting you 7.2% Leech.
class_talents.name: Leeching Poison

class_talents.description: Critical strike chance increased by 2%. Critical strike damage bonus of your attacks that generate combo points increased by 20%.
class_talents.name: Lethality

class_talents.description: Slice and Dice heals you for up to 1% of your maximum health per 3 sec.
class_talents.name: Recuperator

class_talents.description: Haste increased by 3.0%.
class_talents.name: Alacrity

class_talents.description: Increases your maximum Energy by 100 and Energy regeneration by 10%.
class_talents.name: Vigor

class_talents.description: Restore 100 Energy.
class_talents.name: Thistle Tea

class_talents.description: Critically striking with an attack that generates combo points increases the critical strike chance of your next finishing move by 10%.
class_talents.name: Cold Blooded Killer

class_talents.description:
Gain 1 additional max combo point.

Your finishing moves that consume more than 5 combo points have increased effects, and your finishing moves deal 5% increased damage.
class_talents.name: Deeper Stratagem

hero_talents.description:
Flip a Fatebound Coin each time a finishing move consumes 5 or more combo points. Heads increases the damage of your attacks by 10%, lasting 15 sec or until you flip Tails. Tails deals 18,202 Cosmic damage to your target.

For each time the same face is flipped in a row, Heads increases damage by an additional 2% and Tails increases its damage by 10%.
hero_talents.name: Hand of Fate

hero_talents.description: You have a 30% chance to absorb 10% of any damage taken.
hero_talents.name: Tempted Fate

hero_talents.description: Fatebound Coins flipped by Envenom are 33% more likely to match the same face as the last flip.
hero_talents.name: Mean Streak

hero_talents.description: Shadowstep may be used a second time within 3 sec with no cooldown, but its total cooldown is increased by 5 sec.
hero_talents.name: Death's Arrival

hero_talents.description: Critical strike chance increased by 3%.
hero_talents.name: Sometimes Lucky

hero_talents.description: Mutilate, Ambush, and Fan of Knives have a 60% chance to generate 1 additional combo point when they trigger Seal Fate.
hero_talents.name: Deal Fate

hero_talents.description: Caustic Spatter causes an additional 5% of Nature damage dealt to be dealt to affected enemies.
hero_talents.name: Fate Intertwined

hero_talents.description: Activating Deathmark flips a Fatebound Coin and causes it to land on its edge, counting as both Heads and Tails.
hero_talents.name: Edge Case

hero_talents.description: After flipping a Fatebound Coin that ends a streak of 4 or more, flip another that matches the same face.
hero_talents.name: Controlled Chaos

hero_talents.description: Envenom deals 5% more damage when it consumes 5 or more combo points.
hero_talents.name: Delivered Doom

hero_talents.description: Envenom has a 15% chance to flip 3 Fatebound Coins.
hero_talents.name: Overflowing Purse

hero_talents.description: Gain 5 Energy every time you flip a Fatebound Coin. Gain 15 Energy for Coins that land on their edge.
hero_talents.name: Rush to the Inevitable

hero_talents.description: Flipping Heads increases damage by an additional 4%. Damage dealt by flipping Tails is increased by 12%.
hero_talents.name: Ravenholdt Mint

hero_talents.description:
Every 7 coin flips, keep a lucky coin that bends you towards your fate for 12 sec. Your Agility is increased by 4%, the damage and bonuses of Fatebound Coins are increased by 50%, and coin flips are 15% more likely to match the same face as the last flip.

Coin flips do not count toward finding a lucky coin while you have a lucky coin.
hero_talents.name: Lucky Coin

spec_talents.description: Coats your weapons with a Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 21% chance to poison the enemy for 8,983 Nature damage over 12 sec. Subsequent poison applications will instantly deal 829 Nature damage.
spec_talents.name: Deadly Poison

spec_talents.description: Increases your Energy regeneration by 20%.
spec_talents.name: Motivated Murderer

spec_talents.description: Increases maximum Energy by 50.
spec_talents.name: Path of Blood

spec_talents.description:
Slash all enemies within 10 yds dealing 7,814 damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

Copy the longest Garrote and Rupture on the enemies you hit onto up to 2 other enemies. 

Awards 1 combo point.
spec_talents.name: Crimson Tempest

spec_talents.description: Increases Critical Strike chance by 2%.
spec_talents.name: Canny Strikes

spec_talents.description: Garrote deals 50% increased damage and has no cooldown when used from Stealth and for 6 sec after breaking Stealth.
spec_talents.name: Improved Garrote

spec_talents.description: Fan of Knives has 5% increased critical strike chance and its critical strikes always apply your weapon poisons.
spec_talents.name: Thrown Precision

spec_talents.description: Critical strikes with attacks that generate combo points grant an additional combo point per critical strike.
spec_talents.name: Seal Fate

spec_talents.description: Garrote lasts 6 sec longer.
spec_talents.name: Razor Wire

spec_talents.description: Garrote and Rupture damage increased by 15%.
spec_talents.name: Bloody Mess

spec_talents.description:
Carve a deathmark into an enemy, dealing 31,911 Bleed damage and restoring 80 Energy to you over 16 sec. Damage dealt to the target by your Garrote, Rupture, and Lethal Poisons is increased by 75%.

Each time you apply a Lethal Poison to the target, apply it twice.
spec_talents.name: Deathmark

spec_talents.description:
Envenom or Kingsbane apply Caustic Spatter for 10 sec. Limit 1.

Caustic Spatter causes 25% of your Nature damage dealt to splash onto other nearby enemies, reduced beyond 5 targets.
spec_talents.name: Caustic Spatter

spec_talents.description:
Gain 1 additional max combo point.

Your finishing moves that consume more than 5 combo points have increased effects, and your finishing moves deal 5% increased damage.
spec_talents.name: Sanguine Stratagem

spec_talents.description: Increases the damage of your weapon poisons by 20%.
spec_talents.name: Fatal Concoction

spec_talents.description: All damage you deal is increased by 10% while Deathmark is active.
spec_talents.name: Finish the Job

spec_talents.description: Your weapon poisons and Nature or Bleed damage over time abilities deal 2% increased damage to targets for each of your lethal poison or damage over time effects on them.
spec_talents.name: Lethal Dose

spec_talents.description: Envenom has a 5% chance per combo point spent to smash a vial of poison at the target's location, creating a pool of acidic death that deals 12,008 Nature damage over 2 sec to all enemies within it.
spec_talents.name: Poison Bomb

spec_talents.description: Coats your weapons with a Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 21% chance to poison the enemy, dealing 825 Nature damage and applying Amplifying Poison for 12 sec. Envenom can consume 10 stacks of Amplifying Poison to deal 35% increased damage. Max 20 stacks.
spec_talents.name: Amplifying Poison

spec_talents.description:
You regain 3 Energy each time your Garrote or Rupture deal Bleed damage to a target affected by your weapon poisons. Energy gain is reduced for bleeds beyond the first.

If an enemy dies while afflicted by your Rupture, you regain energy based on its remaining duration.
spec_talents.name: Venomous Wounds

spec_talents.description:
Release a powerful poison from your weapons and inject it into your target, dealing 18,276 Nature damage instantly and an additional 19,020 Nature damage over 14 sec. 

Each time you apply a Lethal Poison to a target affected by Kingsbane, Kingsbane damage increases by 20%, up to 1,000%.

Awards 1 combo point.

class_talents.description:
Attack with your off-hand, dealing 3,262 Physical damage, dispelling all enrage effects and applying a concentrated form of your active Non-Lethal poison.

Awards 1 combo point.
class_talents.name: Shiv

class_talents.description: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for 18 sec. Damage may interrupt the effect. Limit 1.
class_talents.name: Blind

class_talents.description: Provides a moment of magic immunity, instantly removing all harmful spell effects. The cloak lingers, causing you to resist harmful spells for 5 sec.
class_talents.name: Cloak of Shadows

class_talents.description: Movement speed increased by 15%.
class_talents.name: Fleet Footed

class_talents.description: Blind has 50% reduced cooldown, 70% reduced duration, and applies to all nearby enemies.
class_talents.name: Airborne Irritant

class_talents.description: Grappling Hook has 1 additional charge.
class_talents.name: Thrill Seeking

class_talents.description: Increases the non-damaging effects of your weapon poisons by 20%.
class_talents.name: Master Poisoner

class_talents.description: Evasion also reduces damage taken by 20%, and Feint also reduces non-area-of-effect damage taken by 20%.
class_talents.name: Elusiveness

class_talents.description: Redirects all threat you cause to the targeted party or raid member, beginning with your next damaging attack within the next 30 sec and lasting 1 hour.
class_talents.name: Tricks of the Trade

class_talents.description: Energy cost of Feint and Crimson Vial reduced by 10.
class_talents.name: Nimble Fingers

class_talents.description: Physical damage taken reduced by 5%.
class_talents.name: Deadened Nerves

class_talents.description: Increases your Agility by 3%.
class_talents.name: Quick Fingers

class_talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Sprint by 60 sec.
class_talents.name: Improved Sprint

class_talents.description: Increases your dodge chance by 100% for 10 sec.
class_talents.name: Evasion

class_talents.description: Increases the healing you receive from Crimson Vial, healing potions, and healthstones by 25%.
class_talents.name: Iron Stomach

class_talents.description: Increases the damage of your weapon poisons by 10%.
class_talents.name: Virulent Poisons

class_talents.description: Feint has 1 additional charge.
class_talents.name: Graceful Guile

class_talents.description: Sprint increases movement speed by an additional 30% and has 4 sec increased duration.
class_talents.name: Featherfoot

class_talents.description: Coats your weapons with a Non-Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, reducing their damage by 4.8% for 1 min.
class_talents.name: Atrophic Poison

class_talents.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your attacks that generate combo points by 5%.
class_talents.name: Deadly Precision

class_talents.description: Your finishing moves deal 6% increased damage.
class_talents.name: Deep Cuts

class_talents.description: You have a 20% chance to partially evade any damage dealt to you, reducing the damage it deals by 20%.
class_talents.name: Danger Sense

class_talents.description: Slice and Dice grants additional attack speed equal to 100% of your Haste.
class_talents.name: Swift Slasher

class_talents.description: Energy cost of finishing moves reduced by 6%.
class_talents.name: Tight Spender

class_talents.description: Adds a Leeching effect to your Lethal poisons, granting you 3.6% Leech.
class_talents.name: Leeching Poison

class_talents.description: Slice and Dice heals you for up to 1% of your maximum health per 3 sec.
class_talents.name: Recuperator

class_talents.description: Haste increased by 3.0%.
class_talents.name: Alacrity

class_talents.description: Increases your maximum Energy by 100 and Energy regeneration by 10%.
class_talents.name: Vigor

class_talents.description:
Adrenaline Rush supercharges 4 combo points.

Damaging finishing moves consume a supercharged combo point to function as if they spent 2 additional combo points.
class_talents.name: Supercharger

class_talents.description:
Restore 100 Energy.

When your Energy is reduced below 30, drink a Thistle Tea.
class_talents.name: Thistle Tea

class_talents.description: Increase the bonus granted when a damaging finishing move consumes a supercharged combo point by 1.
class_talents.name: Forced Induction

class_talents.description:
Gain 1 additional max combo point.

Your finishing moves that consume more than 5 combo points have increased effects, and your finishing moves deal 5% increased damage.
class_talents.name: Deeper Stratagem

hero_talents.description:
Sinister Strike and Ambush now also strike with an Unseen Blade dealing 22,609 damage. Targets struck are Fazed for 10 sec.

Fazed enemies take 8% more damage from you and cannot parry your attacks.

This effect may occur once every 15 sec.
hero_talents.name: Unseen Blade

hero_talents.description: Attacks that generate combo points deal 50% increased critical strike damage to Fazed targets.
hero_talents.name: Surprising Strikes

hero_talents.description: You take 5% reduced damage from Fazed targets.
hero_talents.name: Smoke

hero_talents.description: Unseen Blade and Killing Spree increase the damage of your finishing moves by 4% for 12 sec. Max 5 stacks.
hero_talents.name: Flawless Form

hero_talents.description: Fazed increases damage taken by an additional 3%.
hero_talents.name: Hoodwink

hero_talents.description: Tricks of the Trade's threat redirect duration is increased to 1 hour.
hero_talents.name: So Tricky

hero_talents.description: Killing Spree applies Fazed to any targets struck.
hero_talents.name: Devious Distractions

hero_talents.description: Slice and Dice grants 10% additional attack speed and gives your auto-attacks a chance to refresh your opportunity to strike with Unseen Blade.
hero_talents.name: Thousand Cuts

hero_talents.description: Unseen Blade may now occur once every 15 sec and has 25% chance to strike twice.
hero_talents.name: Flashing Steel

hero_talents.description: Killing Spree has 10% reduced cooldown and allows your next 2 strikes of Unseen Blade to ignore its cooldown.
hero_talents.name: Disorienting Strikes

hero_talents.description:
Activating Adrenaline Rush creates a cloud of smoke for 6 sec, allowing attacks from within the cloud to apply Fazed, stacking up to 1 additional time.

Effect persists for 6 sec after leaving the cloud.
hero_talents.name: Cloud Cover

hero_talents.description: Blade Flurry damage is increased by 25% while Flawless Form is active.
hero_talents.name: Nimble Flurry

hero_talents.description: Pistol Shot has 20% increased critical strike chance and now triggers Unseen Blade when available.
hero_talents.name: Clever Combatant

hero_talents.description: After 4 strikes with Unseen Blade, your next Dispatch will be performed as a Coup de Grace, functioning as if it had consumed 5 additional combo points, and granting you 5 stacks of Flawless Form.
hero_talents.name: Coup de Grace

spec_talents.description:
Sinister Strike has a 30% chance to hit an additional time and grant Opportunity.

 Opportunity
Your next Pistol Shot costs 50% less Energy and deals 120% increased damage.
spec_talents.name: Opportunity

spec_talents.description: Stamina increased by 5%.
spec_talents.name: Combat Stamina

spec_talents.description: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 75%, your maximum Energy by 50, and your attack speed by 20% for 15 sec.
spec_talents.name: Adrenaline Rush

spec_talents.description: Between the Eyes increases your damage dealt by an additional 2%.
spec_talents.name: Expert Duelist

spec_talents.description: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 16%.
spec_talents.name: Combat Potency

spec_talents.description: Between the Eyes and Pistol Shot have 10 yd increased range and deal 20% increased damage.
spec_talents.name: Precision Shot

spec_talents.description: Your finishing moves deal 10% increased damage.
spec_talents.name: Crescendo of Violence

spec_talents.name: Deft Maneuvers

spec_talents.name: Quick Draw

spec_talents.description: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point spent to grant a combo point.
spec_talents.name: Ruthlessness

Charge to your target with your blades out, dealing 45,607 Physical damage to the target and 19,593 to all other nearby enemies. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

While Blade Flurry is active, damage to non-primary targets is increased by 100%.

Generates 25 Energy over 5 sec.

spec_talents.name: Improved Between the Eyes

spec_talents.description: Versatility increased by 3%.

spec_talents.description: Generate full combo points when you gain Adrenaline Rush.
spec_talents.name: Improved Adrenaline Rush

spec_talents.name: Ace Up Your Sleeve

spec_talents.description: Blade Flurry strikes 3 additional enemies and its duration is increased by 3 sec.
spec_talents.name: Dancing Steel

spec_talents.description: Adrenaline Rush magnifies your precision and power, increasing the damage your combo point generating abilities and finishers deal by 20%.
spec_talents.name: Menacing Rush

spec_talents.description: Your auto-attack critical strikes increase the damage and critical strike chance of your next Between the Eyes by 2%, stacking up to 20 times.
spec_talents.name: Zero In

spec_talents.description: Blade Flurry causes your attacks to hit nearby enemies for an additional 8% of their normal damage.
spec_talents.name: Grand Melee

The bonuses granted by your Roll the Bones are stronger.

Bonuses to chance for Sinister Strike to strike twice are 5% greater.
Bonuses to Sinister Strike and Ambush damage are 5% greater.
Bonuses to Restless Blades cooldown reduction are 10% greater.
Jackpot's bonus to critical strike chance is 5% greater.
spec_talents.name: Dragon-Bone Dice

When you gain Opportunity, gain 2 additional charges. Max 6 charges.

Pistol Shot consumes 2 additional charges of Opportunity to fire 2 additional bullets. Additional shots deal 20% reduced damage.

Replaces Corruption.

Generates 1 Soul Shard if the target dies while afflicted.

The seed will detonate early if the target is hit by other detonations, or takes 1,650 damage from your spells.

Shadow Bolt is instant cast and Malefic Grasp channels 50% faster when affected.

 Malefic Grasp
Binds the target in twilight, dealing 42,618 Shadow damage over 3.1 sec.

spec_talents.name: Malefic Grasp

spec_talents.description: Increases critical strike damage dealt by Agony, Wither, and Unstable Affliction by 15%.

 Wrath of Nathreza
Calls down a meteor formed from the ruins of Nathreza that explodes upon impact, dealing 79,478 Shadow damage to all enemies within 10 yds.

Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

class_talents.description: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Incubus, Succubus, Felhunter, or Felguard Summon spell is free and has its casting time reduced by 90%.
class_talents.name: Fel Domination

class_talents.description: All single-target damage done by you and your minions grants you and your pet shadowy shields that absorb 3% of the damage dealt, up to 20% of maximum health.
class_talents.name: Soul Leech

class_talents.description: Increases your movement speed by 70%, but also damages you for 3% of your maximum health every 1 sec. Movement impairing effects may not reduce you below 100% of normal movement speed. Lasts until canceled.
class_talents.name: Burning Rush

class_talents.description:
Your Soul Leech absorption now passively recharges at a rate of 0.2% of maximum health every 1 sec, and may now absorb an additional 10% of maximum health.

Increases your armor by 90%.
class_talents.name: Demon Skin

class_talents.description:
When Soul Leech absorbs damage, 10% of damage taken is absorbed and spread out over 5 sec.

Reduces damage taken by 3.0%.
class_talents.name: Fel Armor

class_talents.description: Reduces the damage dealt by Burning Rush by 10%. Burning Rush increases your movement speed by an additional 20%.
class_talents.name: Fiendish Stride

class_talents.description: Stamina increased by 10%.
class_talents.name: Demonic Embrace

class_talents.description: Increases you and your pets' maximum health by 5%.
class_talents.name: Demonic Fortitude

class_talents.description: Banishes an enemy Demon, Aberration, or Elemental, preventing any action for 30 sec. Limit 1. Casting Banish again on the target will cancel the effect.
class_talents.name: Banish

class_talents.description:
Reduces the target's movement speed by 50% for 12 sec.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.
class_talents.name: Curse of Exhaustion

class_talents.description:
Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by 30% for 1 min.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.
class_talents.name: Curse of Tongues

class_talents.description: Horrifies an enemy target into fleeing, incapacitating for 3 sec and healing you for 25% of maximum health.
class_talents.name: Mortal Coil

class_talents.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 2%.
class_talents.name: Pact of the Annihilan

class_talents.description:
Summons a Demonic Circle for 15 min. Cast Demonic Circle: Teleport to teleport to its location and remove all movement slowing effects.

You also learn:

 Demonic Circle: Teleport
Teleports you to your Demonic Circle and removes all movement slowing effects.
class_talents.name: Demonic Circle

class_talents.description: Increases your haste by 2%.
class_talents.name: Pact of the Satyr

class_talents.description: Increases the range of Mortal Coil by 10 yds and Mortal Coil now heals for an additional 5% of maximum health.
class_talents.name: Improved Mortal Coil

class_talents.description: Sacrifices 20% of your current health to shield you for 200% of the sacrificed health plus an additional 8,525 for 20 sec. Usable while suffering from control impairing effects.
class_talents.name: Dark Pact

class_talents.description: Casting Curse of Exhaustion, Curse of Tongues, or Curse of Weakness now curses all enemies within 10 yds of the target.
class_talents.name: Foul Mouth

class_talents.description: Healthstones heal you for an additional 5% additional health.
class_talents.name: Empowered Healthstone

class_talents.description: Soul Leech may now absorb an additional 5% of your maximum health.
class_talents.name: Fortified Soul

class_talents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Dark Pact by 15 sec.
class_talents.name: Frequent Donor

class_talents.description: Increases your Intellect by 3%.
class_talents.name: Pact of the Eredar

class_talents.description: Increases your Leech by 2%.
class_talents.name: Pact of the Nathrezim

class_talents.description: Unending Resolve reduces damage taken by an additional 15%.
class_talents.name: Strength of Will

class_talents.description: Creates a demonic gateway between two locations. Activating the gateway transports the user to the other gateway. Each player can use a Demonic Gateway only once per 90 sec.
class_talents.name: Demonic Gateway

class_talents.description: Stuns all enemies within 10 yds for 3 sec.
class_talents.name: Shadowfury

class_talents.description: Reduces the cast time of Soulstone and Create Healthstone by 50%.
class_talents.name: Swift Artifice

class_talents.description: 20% of all damage you take is taken by your demon pet instead.
class_talents.name: Soul Link

class_talents.description:
Reduces the cooldown of Shadowfury by 15 sec and increases its radius by 2 yds.

Reduces the cooldown of Howl of Terror by 5 sec and it now fears 5 additional enemies.
class_talents.name: Oppressive Darkness

class_talents.description:
Healthstones you conjure for yourself are now Demonic Healthstones and can be used multiple times in combat. Demonic Healthstones cannot be traded.

 Demonic Healthstone
Instantly restores 30% health. 60 sec cooldown.
class_talents.name: Pact of Gluttony

class_talents.description:
Consumes a Soul Shard, unlocking the hidden power of your spells.

Demonic Circle: Teleport: Increases your movement speed by 50% and makes you immune to snares and roots for 6 sec.

Demonic Gateway: Can be cast instantly.

Drain Life: Gain an absorb shield equal to the amount of healing done for 30 sec. This shield cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health.

Healthstone: Increases the healing of your Healthstone by 30% and increases your maximum health by 20% for 12 sec.
class_talents.name: Soulburn

class_talents.description:
Call forth a cloud of cloying shadow mist that envelopes the target and all enemies within 10 yds, increasing their casting time of all spells by 100% for 12 sec.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse or Blight active per target.
class_talents.name: Blight of Tongues

hero_talents.description:
Spending a Soul Shard on a damaging spell grants Diabolic Ritual for 20 sec. While Diabolic Ritual is active, each Soul Shard spent on a damaging spell reduces its duration by 1 sec.

When Diabolic Ritual expires you gain Demonic Art, causing your next Hand of Gul'dan to summon an Overlord, Mother of Chaos, or Pit Lord that unleashes a devastating attack against your enemies.
hero_talents.name: Diabolic Ritual

hero_talents.description: Enemies damaged by your Overlord have their souls cloven, increasing damage taken by you and your pets by 5% for 15 sec.
hero_talents.name: Cloven Souls

hero_talents.description: Demonic Art increases the damage of your next Hand of Gul'dan by 20% and reduces its cast time by 50%.
hero_talents.name: Touch of Rancora

hero_talents.description:
Mother of Chaos empowers your next Shadow Bolt to become Infernal Bolt.

 Infernal Bolt
Hurl a bolt enveloped in the infernal flames of the abyss, dealing 116,834 Fire damage to your enemy target and generating 3 Soul Shards.
hero_talents.name: Secrets of the Coven

hero_talents.description:
You summon a Diabolic Oculus, up to 3, each time the duration of Diabolic Ritual is reduced by one of your spells.

Diabolic Oculi explode when consuming Demonic Art, dealing 6,144 Fire damage to all enemies within 10 yds of the target. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
hero_talents.name: Diabolic Oculi

hero_talents.description: You always gain the benefit of Soulburn when casting Demonic Circle: Teleport, increasing your movement speed by 50% and making you immune to snares and roots for 6 sec.
hero_talents.name: Soul-Etched Circles

hero_talents.description: Spending Soul Shards on damaging spells while your Demonic Tyrant is active decreases the duration of Diabolic Ritual by 1 additional sec.
hero_talents.name: Infernal Machine

hero_talents.description: Unending Resolve heals you for 30% of your maximum health over 10 sec.
hero_talents.name: Infernal Vitality

hero_talents.description:
Your Diabolic Oculi now cast Diabolic Gaze at your primary demon's target every 1 sec while active.

 Diabolic Gaze
Fire a beam of destructive chaos magic at the target, dealing 2,728 Chaos damage.

Damage is increased by 100% per Demonic Oculus active.
hero_talents.name: Looks That Kill

hero_talents.description: Fire damage increased by 3% and damage dealt by your demons is increased by 3%.
hero_talents.name: Flames of Xoroth

hero_talents.description: Summon Demonic Tyrant is empowered, dealing 70% increased damage and increasing the damage of your demons by 20% while active.
hero_talents.name: Abyssal Dominion

hero_talents.description: Hand of Gul'dan deals 15% increased damage for each Soul Shard spent.
hero_talents.name: Gloom of Nathreza

hero_talents.description: Your Diabolic Oculi observe the battlefield and collect information that is imparted to you upon being exploded, each Diabolic Oculi increasing your Intellect by 2% for 10 sec.
hero_talents.name: Mind's Eyes

hero_talents.description:
Summoning a Pit Lord causes your next Hand of Gul'dan to become Ruination.

 Ruination
Call down a demon-infested meteor from the depths of the Twisting Nether, dealing 83,081 Chaos damage on impact to all enemies within 8 yds of the target and summoning 3 Wild Imps.

Damage is reduced beyond 8 targets.
hero_talents.name: Ruination

spec_talents.description:
Calls down a demonic meteor full of Wild Imps which burst forth to attack the target.

Deals up to 6,105 Shadowflame damage on impact to all enemies within 8 yds of the target and summons 3 Wild Imps.
spec_talents.name: Hand of Gul'dan

spec_talents.description:
Grants access to the following abilities:

 Demonbolt
Send the fiery soul of a fallen demon at the enemy, causing 26,842 Shadowflame damage.

Generates 2 Soul Shards.

 Demonic Core
When your Wild Imps fade or are imploded, you have a 10% chance to absorb their life essence, granting you a stack of Demonic Core. 

When your summoned Dreadstalkers fade away, you have a 100% chance to absorb their life essence, granting you a stack of Demonic Core.

Demonic Core reduces the cast time of Demonbolt by 100%. Maximum 4 stacks.
spec_talents.name: Demoniac

spec_talents.description: Summons 2 ferocious Dreadstalkers to attack the target for 12 sec.
spec_talents.name: Call Dreadstalkers

spec_talents.description: Increases your Intellect by 2%.
spec_talents.name: Fel Intellect

spec_talents.description: Increases your Mastery by 2%.
spec_talents.name: Practiced Rituals

spec_talents.description: When your Dreadstalkers charge into battle, their Dreadbite attack now hits all targets within 8 yards and deals 10% more damage.
spec_talents.name: Dreadlash

spec_talents.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Wild Imp's Fel Firebolt by 15%.
spec_talents.name: Imp-erator

spec_talents.description: Demonic forces suck 6 of your Wild Imps toward the target, and then cause them to violently explode, dealing 8,090 Shadowflame damage to all enemies within 8 yards.
spec_talents.name: Implosion

spec_talents.description: When your Wild Imps cast Fel Firebolt, they have 10% chance to instantly cast another Fel Firebolt at 200% effectiveness.
spec_talents.name: Infernal Rapidity

spec_talents.description: Reduces the cast time of Shadow Bolt by 40% and increases its damage by 60%.
spec_talents.name: Rune of Shadows

spec_talents.description: Your Dreadstalkers' attacks have a 40% chance to trigger an additional Dreadbite.
spec_talents.name: Carnivorous Stalkers

spec_talents.description: Hand of Gul'dan now empowers 1 of the Wild Imps it summons, increasing its damage dealt by 100%.
spec_talents.name: Imp Gang Boss

spec_talents.description: Damaging critical strikes dealt by you and your demons deal 230% damage instead of the usual 200%.
spec_talents.name: Demonic Brutality

spec_talents.description: You passively summon a Wild Imp to fight for you every 12 sec.
spec_talents.name: Inner Demons

spec_talents.description:
Summon a Demonic Tyrant that damages your target for 20 sec. 

Damage dealt by Demonic Tyrant is increased by 10% for each Wild Imp and Dreadstalker active.
spec_talents.name: Summon Demonic Tyrant

spec_talents.description: The fangs of your Dreadstalkers are coated in corrosive bile, causing Dreadbite to deal additional damage equal to 50% of damage dealt as Plague damage.
spec_talents.name: Blighted Maw

spec_talents.description: Your Demonic Tyrant also empowers you while active, increasing your haste by 8%.
spec_talents.name: Tyrant's Oblation

spec_talents.description:
Your Demonic Tyrant is equipped with armor forged within Antorus, increasing their armor by 10%. While summoned, your Demonic Tyrant now assaults enemies with powerful melee attacks.

 Burning Cleave
Cleaves the area in front of the caster, inflicting 5,601 Shadowflame damage. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
spec_talents.name: Antoran Armaments

spec_talents.description: Increases the attack speed of your Dreadstalkers by 10% and their critical strike chance by 15%.
spec_talents.name: Flametouched

spec_talents.description: Your Demonic Tyrant lasts an additional 5 sec and extends the duration of your Dreadstalkers by 15 sec when summoned.
spec_talents.name: Reign of Tyranny

spec_talents.description: Increases Mastery by 3% and reduces the cast time of your Summon Demonic Tyrant and Summon Felguard by 0.5 sec.
spec_talents.name: Master Summoner

spec_talents.description: Call Dreadstalkers costs 4 less Soul Shards and its cast time is reduced by 200%.
spec_talents.name: Demonic Calling

spec_talents.description: Your demons deal 1.0% increased damage for each demon you control.
spec_talents.name: Hellbent Commander

spec_talents.description:
Summons an Imp Lord to assist you in combat for 20 sec and will remove 1 harmful effect from you when summoned. 

Transforms into Singe Magic while on cooldown.
spec_talents.name: Grimoire: Imp Lord

spec_talents.description: Call Dreadstalkers also summons a Vilefiend that assists you in combat for 15 sec.
spec_talents.name: Summon Vilefiend

spec_talents.description:
Power Siphon and Implosion summon 1 Imp Gang Boss for every 2 Wild Imps sacrificed. Wild Imps summoned this way gain Unstable Soul.

 Unstable Soul
Increases damage done by 50% and Fel Firebolt now jumps to 4 additional targets.
spec_talents.name: To Hell and Back

spec_talents.description:
Your Summon Vilefiend becomes Summon Charhound and learns the following ability:

 Infernal Presence
Cloaked in the ever-burning flames of the abyss, dealing 545 Fire damage to enemies within 10 yards every 0.8 sec.
spec_talents.name: Mark of F'harg

spec_talents.description:
While Dominion of Argus is active, Hand of Gul'dan refunds 1 Soul Shard.

Demons summoned by Dominion of Argus last an additional 4 sec.
spec_talents.name: Dominion of Argus

spec_talents.description: Increases the duration of Dominion of Argus by 20 sec and increases damage dealt by Hand of Gul'dan by 40%.
spec_talents.name: Dominion of Argus

spec_talents.description: Summoning your Demonic Tyrant leaves open a portal to Argus for 25 sec, causing every 2 casts of Hand of Gul'dan to summon a subjugated demon that serves you for 14 sec.
spec_talents.name: Dominion of Argus

hero_talents.description:
Casting Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn grants Diabolic Ritual for 20 sec. If Diabolic Ritual is already active, its duration is reduced by 1 sec instead.

When Diabolic Ritual expires you gain Demonic Art, causing your next Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn to summon an Overlord, Mother of Chaos, or Pit Lord that unleashes a devastating attack against your enemies.
hero_talents.name: Diabolic Ritual

hero_talents.description: Enemies damaged by your Overlord have their souls cloven, increasing damage taken by you and your pets by 5% for 15 sec.
hero_talents.name: Cloven Souls

hero_talents.description:
Demonic Art increases the damage of your next Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn by 20% and reduces its cast time by 50%.

Casting Chaos Bolt reduces the duration of Diabolic Ritual by 1 additional sec.
hero_talents.name: Touch of Rancora

hero_talents.description:
Mother of Chaos empowers your next Incinerate to become Infernal Bolt.

 Infernal Bolt
Hurl a bolt enveloped in the infernal flames of the abyss, dealing 61,368 Fire damage to your enemy target and generating 2 Soul Shards.
hero_talents.name: Secrets of the Coven

You summon a Diabolic Oculus, up to 3, each time the duration of Diabolic Ritual is reduced by one of your spells.

Diabolic Oculi explode when consuming Demonic Art, dealing 8,059 Fire damage to all enemies within 10 yds of the target. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
hero_talents.name: Diabolic Oculi

hero_talents.name: Infernal Vitality

Damage is increased by 100% per Demonic Oculus active.

hero_talents.description: Fire damage increased by 4% and damage dealt by your demons is increased by 4%.

Damage is further increased by your critical strike chance and is reduced beyond 8 targets.
